programme.title: Monk / Monk
programme.sub-title: Mr. Monk, ein Playboy und viele schone Madchen
programme.desc: The criminal officer Adrian Monk quickly became a little bit of a small body due to his special facilities in his profession. He has a photographic memory and can make a track even from the smallest indications. Since the death of his beloved wife Trudy due to a mysterious attack, however, he has suffered from strong fears and obsessive -he -forcendants, which leads to his suspension from service at the San Fransisco Police Department. After he has locked himself up in his apartment for three years, he finally becomes a self -timed as a private detective and is repeatedly asked by the police for support. With the help of his former boss Captain Leland Stottlemeyer and his personal assistant Sharona Fleming Lost Monk, the crime trap that nobody else can loose. / Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Er hat ein fotografisches Gedachtnis und kann selbst aus kleinsten Hinweisen eine Spur basteln. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. programme.title: Asked - hunted / Gefragt - Gejagt
programme.desc: In the quiz show, a team of four candidates competes against the "Jager". This is not an easy task, because the "Jagers" are proven quiz professionals from the German quiz national team, including even the German quizmaster. In the first round, the candidates set up a game sum individually, which they have to defend together against the "Jager" in the second round to move into the final. In the final, the remaining candidates in the team compete against the "Jager" and defend the money earned so far. You have to answer as many questions as possible within two minutes. If the candidates answer more questions than the "Jager", they won. / In der Quizsendung tritt ein Team von vier Kandidaten gegen den "Jager" an. Dies ist keine leichte Aufgabe, denn die "Jager" sind ausgewiesene Quizprofis aus der deutschen Quiznationalmannschaft, darunter sogar der Deutsche Quizmaster. In der ersten Runde bauen die Kandidaten einzeln eine Spielsumme auf, die sie in der zweiten Runde gemeinsam gegen den "Jager" verteidigen mussen, um in das Finale einzuziehen. Im Finale treten die verbliebenen Kandidaten im Team gegen den "Jager" an und verteidigen das bisher erspielte Geld. Sie mussen innerhalb von zwei Minuten so viele Fragen wie moglich beantworten. programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Made in Italy - Champions of Italy / Made in Italy - Champions of Italy
programme.desc: The largest League competition in Italy was founded in 1898. Twenty clubs are struggled every year for the prestigious title of Champions series A. / Najveće ligaško takmičenje u Italiji osnovano je 1898 godine. Dvadeset klubova se svake godine bori za prestižnu titulu prvaka Serije A.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, a yearly continental competition in which only the champions of their states perform. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of its state. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football: English EFL Cup / Fudbal: Engleski EFL kup
programme.desc: The Cup League Unlike your popular "brother" Fa Cup is starting its history in the 1960s and centuries and time using the possibility of playing under the spotlights in evening hours as soon as possible. All matches are playing in the middle of the week until the only final plays on a single match on the neutral field at Vembla Stadium in London. The interestingness of this competition is that the final is played in February or March, and the winner is secured by a placement in the UEFA Europa League if it has not already secured the placement through Premieršip. The first winners of the competition were the Footballers Aston Villas in 1961. Years. / Engleski Liga kup za razliku od svog popularnijeg "brata" FA kupa svoju istoriju započinje 60-tih godina 20. veka i time koristeći mogućnost igranja pod reflektorima u večernje sate što pre nije bilo moguće. Sve utakmice se igraju usred sedmice dok se jedino finale igra na jednu utakmicu na neutralnom terenu na stadionu Vembli u Londonu. Zanimljivost ovog takmičenja je da se finale igra već u februaru ili martu, a pobednik osigurava plasman u UEFA Ligi Evrope ukoliko već nije osigurao plasman kroz Premieršip. Prvi pobednici takmičenja su bili fudbaleri Aston Vile 1961. godine.

programme.title: Youth sports games / Sportske igre mladih
programme.desc: Youth sports games are the biggest manifestation for children and youth in this region whose main goal is to promote a healthy lifestyle and friendship. For the 2nd year, elementary students and high school students from the Republic of Croatia, 8 years from Bosnia and Herzegovina and 5 years from the Republic of Serbia for free participation in various competitions. / Sportske igre mladih najveća su manifestacija za djecu i omladinu na ovim prostorima čiji je osnovni cilj promocija zdravog načina života i prijateljstva. Već 22. godinu, osnovnoškolcima i srednjoškolcima iz Republike Hrvatske, 8. godina iz Bosne i Hercegovine i 5. godina iz Republike Srbije omogućujemo potpuno besplatno učešće na raznim takmičenjima.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - 2. ABA League / Košarka - 2. ABA Liga
programme.desc: 2. The ABA league is the second degree of the regional basketball ABA league. Krka New place is the historical first winner of the ABA 2. Leagues, competitions founded in the 2017/2018 season. With a victory on the Fajnal Forum and a goblet intended for the winner, the Krka team achieved a placement in 1. ABA league from the next season. The league participates 12 teams that seek the road to four best teams and placement on Fainal for. Purpose of the ABA 2. The league is to enable smaller basketball environments competition with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. Krka Novo Mesto je istoriski prvi pobjednik ABA 2. lige, takmičenja koje je osnovano u sezoni 2017/2018. Uz pobedu na fajnal foru i peharu namjenjenom pobjedniku, ekipa Krke ostvarila je i plasman u 1. ABA ligu od sljedeće sezone. U ligi učestvuje 12 ekipa koje nakon dvokružnog sistema utakmica traže put prema četiri najbolje ekipe i plasman na fajnal for. Svrha ABA 2. lige je omogućiti manjim košarkaškim sredinama takmičenje sa jačom regionalnom konkurencijom.

programme.title: Football - 2. Spanish League / Fudbal - 2. španska liga
programme.desc: Founded in 1929. years, Segunda is another league in size in Spain. The total number of 22 teams fighting for entry into the example, the first Spanish football league. Two first-placed Segund teams conquer direct placement above as the third-placed through the barrage can handle their place in examples. Uncertain matches and high levels of football quality and the technical aspect of the game consists of Segunda extremely media-accompanied competition. / Osnovana 1929. godine, Segunda je druga liga po veličini u Španiji. Ukupno broji 22 ekipe koje se bore za ulazak u Primeru, prvu špansku fudbalsku ligu. Dve prvoplasirane ekipe Segunde osvajaju direktan plasman gore dok trećeplasirani kroz baraž može izboriti svoje mjesto u Primeri. Neizvesne utakmice i visok nivo kvaliteta fudbala i tehnički aspekt igre čine Segundu izrazito medijski propraćenim takmičenjem.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Black space / Черно пространство
programme.desc: It all starts in an ordinary morning in high school of a small town. Anonymous people with unicorns and pistol masks invade and begin to shoot everyone. Four students were killed and there were many injured. The terrorist act was carried out during a ceremony dedicated to the day of the dead in the wars and victims of terror. The nightmare happened changes people's lives. Police are launching an investigation. The experienced and harsh detective Davidi is taken over by him. They find a shocking fact-people with masks are most likely students from the same school. Interrogations begin and one must understand who is lying on purpose, who just doesn't remember anything, and what is the reason for the terrible events. / Всичко започва в една обикновена сутрин в гимназията на един малък град. Анонимни хора с маски на еднорози и пистолети нахлуват и започват да стрелят по всички. Четирима ученици са убити и има много ранени. Терористичният акт е извършен по време на церемония, посветена на Деня на загиналите във войните и жертвите на терора. Случилият се кошмар променя живота на хората. Полицията започва разследване. Поема го опитният и суров детектив Давиди. Откриват шокиращ факт – хората с маските най-вероятно са ученици от същото училище. Започват разпити и трябва да се разбере кой лъже нарочно, кой просто не помни нищо и коя е причината за ужасните събития.

programme.title: World Rhythmic Gymnastics Championships: Finals of appliances / Световно първенство по художествена гимнастика: Финали на уреди
programme.desc: Beautiful sport has attracted the attention of many viewers because of the great Bulgarian success over the years. In the Brazilian city, our country will be represented by the European vice -champion this year and the winner of 3 gold medals on the Stiliana Nikolova and Eva Brezalieva, who will participate in the individual race. The ensemble, with coach Vesela Dimitrova, will also fight for a place among the best in the huge competition of 36 groups. The Championship in Brazil will gather over 300 gymnasts from a record 76 countries. The event seems to be the beginning of a new era in sports-with new combinations, updated groups and young hopes that will fight for a place among the best in the world. The World Cup in Rio will offer not only contested sports race, but also inspiration, artistry and emotion-qualities that make rhythmic gymnastics one of the most watched sports in the world. / Красивият спорт привлича вниманието на множество зрители, заради големите български успехи през годините. В бразилския град страната ни ще бъде представена от европейската вицешампионка от тази година и носителка на 3 златни медала на уредите Стилияна Николова и Ева Брезалиева, които ще участват в индивидуалната надпревара. Ансамбълът, с треньор Весела Димитрова, също ще се бори за място сред най-добрите в огромната конкуренция от 36 състава. Шампионатът в Бразилия ще събере над 300 гимнастички от рекордните 76 държави. Събитието сякаш бележи началото на нова ера в спорта – с нови съчетания, обновени състави и млади надежди, които ще се борят за място сред най-добрите в света. Световното първенство в Рио ще предложи не само оспорвана спортна надпревара, но и вдъхновение, артистизъм и емоция – качества, които правят художествената гимнастика един от най-гледаните спортове в света.

programme.title: Football: UEFA European Women's Championship 2025: Finals: England - Spain / Футбол: УЕФА Европейско първенство за жени 2025: Финал: Англия - Испания
programme.desc: The 16 best ladies' teams on the continent gather in Switzerland to fight for the Cup in the 14th European Championship. Отборът на Англия ще защитава титлата си, спечелена преди 3 години на родна земя. Най-големите конкурентки са световните шампионки от Испания, които са и отборът с най- предно класиране от Европа в ранглистата на ФИФА – второ място. Hanoch spoke on television. / При разпитите всички показания са противоречиви и предизвикват все повече въпроси. Опитният Давиди за първи път се сблъсква с такава странна терористична атака. Той споделя с полицаите, че е сигурен, че са от учениците. Но колегите му не са съгласни. 10 и 11 класове са били в кметството. 356 са били в училището и всички са заподозрени. Пистолетите са само 4. Директорът Ханох настоява да отвори училището и да се провеждат занятия. Но четиримата убийци са на свобода и не е безопасно. Нямат доказателства. Репортери засипват Давиди с въпроси. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, natjecanje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. programme.title: Braunschweig - Stuttgart, Football, German Cup / Braunschweig - Stuttgart, Nogomet, Njemački kup
programme.desc: DFB-Pokal-(Sport. Program, Germany, 2025) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Cup dates back to 1935 when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pocal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, with the first four teams on the third league rankings. The rest of the participants come by the winner of the regional buyers. The matches are played for a single Cup system in which extensions are played after a regular 90 minutes and after the penalty box if the winner does not decide by then. The finals have been played every year starting in 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The Cup winner provides a placement in the UEFA Europa League ... / DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka, 2025) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi...

programme.title: Lyon - Manchester United, Nogomet, Europa Liga / Lyon - Manchester United, Nogomet, Europa liga
programme.desc: Football: UEFA Europa League - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the 1971 European Football Federation. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. When it was renamed the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and every year is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year ... / Football: UEFA Europa League - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Europa Ligu. Tijekom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Merkel's legacy - 10 years "We can do it!" / Merkels Erbe - 10 Jahre "Wir schaffen das!"
programme.desc: Only a few events have shaped the Federal Republic of Germany as the "escape summer" in 2015. On August 31, 2015, the then Chancellor Angela Merkel (CDU) pretended the course with the words "We can" do this ". The sentence became the credo of her escape policy in the self -imposed, huge task: hundreds of thousands of flights came to Germany after Merkel left the borders open in the late summer of 2015. the "Tagessehemen" moderator Ingo Zamperoni draws a balance: What did the "escape summer" do with our country in 2015? Did we make it? Where has integration succeeded and where are there problems? And how did the events to change the political landscape in Germany ten years ago? Ingo Zamperoni meets Chancellor a. D. Angela Merkel for an interview. Together they look in the summer of 2015 and how Germany has changed since then.ingo Zamperoni Spurt also the moods in the country. He hits the masters of Schwabisch Gmund, Richard Arnold (CDU), whose apparently inexperienced confidence seems to be lost and who speaks of having reached the load limit of his city. He accompanies Bavarian border police officers on the German-Easter border at a veil search and sees how the border controls have been intensified again. He visits the nurse Mohammed Alasaad in Cottbus, who came from Syria in early 2016 and has now trained other foster people. He drives to Solingen and gets a picture of what the knife attack did with the city a year ago. And he visits an escape accommodation that was presumably attacked by right -wing extremists. After all, he speaks to journalist Robin Alexander Daruber how the escape policy Angela Merkel has also politically changed our country. Documentation by author and director Birgit Warnke is raising the little stories and large political strange and arranges with the help of data: How many refugees are now in the works? How did the crime developed? How much violence is there against fleeing? And how many escape lodges have we taken up in the past ten years compared to other European countries? / Nur wenige Ereignisse haben die Bundesrepublik Deutschland so gepragt wie der "Fluchtlingssommer" 2015. Am 31. August 2015 gab die damalige Bundeskanzlerin Angela Merkel (CDU) den Kurs mit den mittlerweile fast schon historisch gewordenen Worten "Wir schaffen das" vor. Der Satz wurde zum Credo ihrer Fluchtlingspolitik bei der selbst auferlegten, gewaltigen Aufgabe: Hunderttausende Fluchtlinge kamen nach Deutschland, nachdem Merkel die Grenzen im Spatsommer 2015 offen lieSS, und sollten integriert werden.In der Doku "Merkels Erbe - 10 Jahre Wir schaffen das!" zieht der "tagesthemen"-Moderator Ingo Zamperoni eine Bilanz: Was hat der "Fluchtlingssommer" 2015 mit unserem Land gemacht? Haben wir es geschafft? Wo ist die Integration gelungen und wo gibt es Probleme? Und wie haben die Ereignisse vor zehn Jahren die politische Landschaft in Deutschland verandert?Fur die Doku trifft Ingo Zamperoni die Bundeskanzlerin a. D. Angela Merkel zu einem Interview. Gemeinsam blicken sie in den Sommer 2015 und darauf, wie sich Deutschland seitdem verandert hat.Ingo Zamperoni spurt zudem den Stimmungen im Land nach. Er trifft den Burgermeister von Schwabisch Gmund, Richard Arnold (CDU), dessen scheinbar unerschutterliche Zuversicht verloren zu gehen scheint und der davon spricht, die Belastungsgrenze seiner Stadt erreicht zu haben. Er begleitet bayerische Grenzpolizisten an der deutsch-osterreichischen Grenze bei einer Schleierfahndung und sieht, wie die Grenzkontrollen nochmals intensiviert wurden. Er besucht den Pfleger Mohammed Alasaad in Cottbus, der Anfang 2016 aus Syrien kam und mittlerweile andere Pflegekrafte ausbildet. Er fahrt nach Solingen und macht sich ein Bild, was der Messeranschlag vor einem Jahr mit der Stadt gemacht hat. Und er besucht eine Fluchtlingsunterkunft, die mutmaSSlich von Rechtsextremen angegriffen wurde. SchlieSSlich spricht er mit dem Journalisten Robin Alexander daruber, wie die Fluchtlingspolitik Angela Merkels unser Land auch politisch verandert hat.Die Dokumentation von Autorin und Regisseurin Birgit Warnke erzahlt die kleinen Geschichten und groSSen politischen Strange und ordnet mithilfe von Daten ein: Wie viele Gefluchtete sind inzwischen in Arbeit? Wie hat sich die Kriminalitat entwickelt? Wie viel Gewalt gibt es gegen Fluchtlinge? Und wie viele Fluchtlinge haben wir im Vergleich zu anderen europaischen Landern in den letzten zehn Jahren uberhaupt aufgenommen?

programme.title: Thank you, but ... ten years after Merkel's promise / Danke, aber ... Zehn Jahre nach Merkels Versprechen
programme.desc: "Everything is new, everything is already," Mahsa Narimani Germany had imagined. "Where equal rights, performance and human rights pay," thought Heva Gharibi when he still lived in Iran. Both fled to Germany in 2015 - in the summer when Angela Merkel "we can do it". Did we make it? This question is still moving the country. In the documentary "Thank you, but ... 10 years after Merkel's promise", those of the balance sheet, about which are spoken so often: the refugees themselves. The film is raised by the stories of people who have found their place in Germany, but also by those whose expectations have been exchanged in or on the integration system. Sadegh Ranjbar and Mahsa Narimani, a couple from Iran, were loudly insulted with xenophobic slogans when they arrived in the Sachsian town of Clausnitz. Today they live with their two children near Hamburg and Grund their own small company - a limousine service. Heva Gharibi, a Kurdish refugee, entered the hunger strike at a closed EU border in 2015 and approached his mouth in protest. To date, he is only tolerated in Germany, lives in an escape home, hardly speaks German and has no work permit. How do you look back on time? What has been successful since then and where are there problems? In addition, the refugees in the film speak to the woman, who decided to record people in Germany at the time - with Angela Merkel. / "Alles ist neu, alles ist schon", so hatte sich Mahsa Narimani Deutschland vorgestellt. "Wo Gleichberechtigung, Leistung und Menschenrechte zahlen", dachte Heva Gharibi, als er noch im Iran lebte. Beide sind 2015 nach Deutschland geflohen - in dem Sommer, als Angela Merkel "Wir schaffen das" sagte. Haben wir es geschafft? Diese Frage bewegt bis heute das Land. In der Dokumentation "Danke, aber ... 10 Jahre nach Merkels Versprechen" ziehen diejenigen Bilanz, uber die so oft gesprochen wird: die Gefluchteten selbst.Der Film erzahlt die Geschichten von Menschen, die ihren Platz in Deutschland gefunden haben, aber auch von jenen, deren Erwartungen enttauscht wurden, die im oder am Integrationssystem gescheitert sind. Sadegh Ranjbar und Mahsa Narimani, ein Ehepaar aus dem Iran, wurden bei ihrer Ankunft im sachsischen Ort Clausnitz lautstark mit fremdenfeindlichen Parolen beschimpft. Heute leben sie mit ihren beiden Kindern in der Nahe von Hamburg und grunden ihr eigenes kleines Unternehmen - ein Limousinen-Service. Heva Gharibi, ein kurdischer Gefluchteter, trat 2015 an einer geschlossenen EU-Grenze in den Hungerstreik und nahte sich aus Protest den Mund zu. Bis heute ist er in Deutschland nur geduldet, lebt in einem Fluchtlingsheim, spricht kaum Deutsch und hat keine Arbeitserlaubnis.Wie blicken sie auf die Zeit zuruck? Was ist seitdem gelungen und wo gibt es Probleme? Daruber sprechen die Gefluchteten im Film mit der Frau, die damals maSSgeblich entschied, Menschen in Deutschland aufzunehmen - mit Angela Merkel.

programme.title: Far and Flash / Feuer and Flamme
programme.desc: In the middle of the night, a glaring fire in Heidelberg alerts a bright fire license: a garage is in full fire, flames hit the night sky. When the operating powers arrived, the fire has already been on the adjacent residential building. While the garage is felled, further squads try to get the fire in the house and prevent it from spreading to neighboring house. But the ferrisherd now sits deep in the non -accessible attic. For the residents, the nerves lie blank: can the fire brigade still stop spreading and protect their home and apartments? In addition, the suspicion of asbestos in the old buildings increases the risk. / Mitten in der Nacht alarmiert ein greller Feuerschein Anwohner und Feuerwehr in Heidelberg: Eine Garage steht in Vollbrand, Flammen schlagen meterhoch in den Nachthimmel. Beim Eintreffen der Einsatzkrafte hat das Feuer bereits auf das angrenzende Wohnhaus ubergegriffen. Wahrend die Garage geloscht wird, versuchen weitere Trupps, den Brand im Wohnhaus einzudammen und ein Übergreifen auf Nachbarhauser zu verhindern. Doch der Brandherd sitzt mittlerweile tief im nicht zuganglichen Dachboden. Bei den Anwohnern liegen die Nerven blank: Kann die Feuerwehr das Ausbreiten noch stoppen und ihre Hauser und Wohnungen schutzen? Zusatzlich erhoht der Verdacht auf Asbest in den alten Bauten das Risiko.

programme.title: Far and Flash / Feuer and Flamme
programme.desc: A young man has an accident on a downhill route on the Heidelberg Konigsstuhl. There is no getting through for the ambulance, the fire brigade jerks out with a special vehicle and extraction. In the race against the time, the operating powers caught by steep, rough landing - every movement pays, the search becomes a obstacle. And: a man and a bike are really in the terminal - also an assignment for the Heidelberg fire brigade. / Ein junger Mann verungluckt auf einer Downhillstrecke am Heidelberger Konigsstuhl. Fur den Rettungswagen ist kein Durchkommen, die Feuerwehr ruckt mit Spezialfahrzeug und -ausrustung aus. Im Wettlauf gegen die Zeit kampfen sich die Einsatzkrafte durch steiles, unwegsames Gelande - jeder Handgriff zahlt, die Suche wird zum Hindernislauf.In einer Wohnung sorgt eine ratselhafte Rauchentwicklung fur Kopfzerbrechen. Und: Ein Mann steckt samt Fahrrad richtig in der Klemme - auch ein Einsatz fur die Heidelberger Feuerwehr.

programme.title: Hubert and Staller / Hubert und Staller
programme.desc: Hubert and Staller are witnessing a petrol station. The Rauber can flee, but the case seems to be drawn quickly: the DNA traces at the scene belong to Heiko Martens. There is only one problem: the man is dead! Martens was reported to be missing after a boat huck. And only officially explained for deceased for a short time. The grieving widow Sabine Jager-Martens hopes that her husband could still live. The Sister of the dead, Roswitha Martens, follows his very own theory: her brother Sabine wanted to kill Heiko, who was indebted, to get his life insurance at the time, but her attempt failed. Now her brother has returned to throat and prevent the money from paying out. Hubert and Staller suspect that the couple played off: Heiko wanted to get rid of his debts and only exchanged his death. Now he is back to sack life insurance with his wife. The two watch a meeting of the widow with a mysterious man. Is it Heiko? But when Hubert and Staller record the persecution, he escapes again. Then a determined video recording reveals: It is not the dead man that has caught the petrol station, but his sister! Has she exchanged, Heiko was still living so that the brother -in -law ends empty? But that doesn't make any sense. Because Roswitha continues to assert that her brother has her brother on her conscience, as the boat on which Martens is supposed to have a crash on is brought into play, Hubert and Staller have to ask whether the dead sister is not right ... / Hubert und Staller werden Zeugen eines Tankstellenuberfalls. Der Rauber kann fliehen, doch der Fall scheint schnell gelost: Die DNA-Spuren am Tatort gehoren zu Heiko Martens. Es gibt nur ein Problem: Der Mann ist tot! Martens wurde nach einem Bootsungluck als vermisst gemeldet und erst kurzlich offiziell fur verstorben erklart. Die trauernde Witwe Sabine Jager-Martens hegt Hoffnung, dass ihr Mann noch leben konnte. Die Schwester des Toten, Roswitha Martens, verfolgt eine ganz eigene Theorie: Ihre Schwagerin Sabine wollte den verschuldeten Heiko damals auf dem Boot umbringen, um an seine Lebensversicherung zu kommen, doch ihr Versuch schlug fehl. Jetzt ist ihr Bruder zuruckgekehrt, um sich zu rachen und die Auszahlung des Geldes zu verhindern. Hubert und Staller vermuten dahinter ein abgekartetes Spiel des Ehepaars: Heiko wollte seine Schulden loswerden und hat seinen Tod nur vorgetauscht. Nun ist er zuruck, um mit seiner Frau die Lebensversicherung einzusacken. Die beiden beobachten ein Treffen der Witwe mit einem mysteriosen Mann. Handelt es sich um Heiko? Doch als Hubert und Staller die Verfolgung aufnehmen, entkommt er erneut. Dann offenbart eine entschlusselte Videoaufzeichnung: Nicht der Tote hat die Tankstelle uberfallen, sondern seine Schwester! Hat sie vorgetauscht, Heiko wurde noch leben, damit die Schwagerin leer ausgeht? Doch so ganz ergibt das keinen Sinn. Denn Roswitha beteuert nach wie vor, dass ihre Schwagerin ihren Bruder auf dem Gewissen hat.Als dann auch noch das Boot, auf dem Martens verungluckt sein soll, ins Spiel gebracht wird, mussen sich Hubert und Staller fragen, ob die Schwester des Toten nicht doch recht hat ...

programme.title: Murder in the north / Morden im Norden
programme.desc: Finn and Lars are pursuing a sports car, the driver of which is apparently minor year. The boy suddenly loses control over the car and accidentally loses. When the commissioners rush to help him, he pulls a gun and threatens the two. There is a scramble, a shot all and the boy breaks down. An emergency surgery saves his life, but Finn makes a lot of promotion. Prosecutor Zobel is forced to suspend him from duty. The boy, if they had acted according to the regulations, could never pull a gun, but why did the boy had a gun at all? Finn begins to determine without a brand. The seriously injured boy is Arthur Grun, the 14-year son of a Lubeck brothel owner, is accused of forced prostitution. While Finn is in danger of losing the job because of his "private" investigation, Lars tries to find out more about Hauke ​​Grun, Arthur's powerful father. But he absolutely wants to prevent further investigations and starts counter -striking. / Finn und Lars verfolgen einen Sportwagen, dessen Fahrer augenscheinlich minderjahrig ist. Plotzlich verliert der Junge die Kontrolle uber das Auto und verungluckt. Als die Kommissare ihm zu Hilfe eilen, zieht er eine Waffe und bedroht die beiden. Es kommt zu einem Gerangel, ein Schuss lost sich und der Junge bricht getroffen zusammen. Eine Not-OP rettet sein Leben, aber Finn macht sich groSSe Vorwurfe. Staatsanwaltin Zobel sieht sich gezwungen, ihn vom Dienst zu suspendieren. Der Junge hatte, wenn sie nach Vorschrift gehandelt hatten, nie eine Waffe ziehen konnen.Aber wieso hatte der Junge uberhaupt eine Waffe? Finn beginnt ohne Marke zu ermitteln. Bei dem schwerverletzten Jungen handelt es sich um Arthur Grun, den 14-jahrigen Sohn eines Lubecker Bordellbesitzers, dem Zwangsprostitution vorgeworfen wird. Wahrend Finn in Gefahr gerat, wegen seiner "privaten" Ermittlungen den Job zu verlieren, versucht Lars mehr uber Hauke Grun, Arthurs machtigen Vater, herauszufinden. Aber der will weitere Ermittlungen unbedingt verhindern und setzt zum Gegenschlag an.

programme.desc: The author and publisher Christoph (Heikko Deutschmann), who is as charming as well -lookeded as well as well -looked. When her husband supposedly caught the two in flagranti, the events are overwhelmed: Christoph is admitted to the hospital after falling stairs, where he is already swaying on the death bed. At the same time, Friederike and Alois learn the truth about his supposed cancer, but Christoph has already stormed from the hospital to put an end to his life. Alois and Friederike have to put the gas in the truest sense in order to protect this imaginary patient from great stupidity. / Der ebenso charmante wie gut aussehende Autor und Verleger Christoph (Heikko Deutschmann) ist ein echter Perfektionist. Ob es um die von ihm verfassten Heimwerker-Ratgeber geht, um die Einrichtung seines Hauses oder um seine Ehe: Der treu sorgende Familienvater uberlasst nichts dem Zufall. Seine Frau Friederike (Aglaia Szyszkowitz) beobachtet die Kontrollsucht ihres Gatten mit einer Mischung aus Genervtheit und liebevollem Spott. Aber Christoph ist nicht nur ein besessener Perfektionist - er hat auch einen ausgepragten Hang zur Hypochondrie. Und der fuhrt eines Tages dazu, dass Christoph glaubt, unheilbar an Krebs erkrankt zu sein - dabei hatte der behandelnde Arzt lediglich das Rontgenbild vertauscht, weil sich Christoph in der Sprechstunde wieder einmal vorgedrangt hatte. Die wichtigste Frage fur den vermeintlich Todgeweihten lautet nun: Wie soll seine Familie ohne ihn weiterleben? Aus reiner Fursorge beschlieSSt Christoph, Friederike seine Krankheit zu verschweigen und heimlich per Kontaktanzeige einen wurdigen Nachfolger zu suchen. Friederike ist sichtlich irritiert von dieser neuartigen Mannerfreundschaft - da kommen ihr die Komplimente und kleinen Flirts des charmanten Handwerkers Klaus (Thomas Scharff) gerade recht. Als ihr Mann die beiden vermeintlich in flagranti erwischt, uberschlagen sich die Ereignisse: Christoph wird nach einem Treppensturz ins Krankenhaus eingeliefert, wo er sich bereits auf dem Totenbett wahnt. Zur gleichen Zeit erfahren Friederike und Alois die Wahrheit uber seine vermeintliche Krebs-Erkrankung, aber Christoph ist bereits aus dem Hospital gesturmt, um seinem Leben ein Ende zu setzen. programme.title: We are sisters / Wir sind doch Schwestern
programme.desc: In 1994 the three Janssen sisters come together in 1994 to celebrate the 100th birthday of the elders on the Lower Rhine Gutshof Verhoeven. However, the jubilee Hiltrud (Hildegard Schmahl) has come anything but voluntarily. Her two-year younger sister Martha (Gertrud Roll) wanted to force that after decades she speaks to the radio again with the 84-year "Nesthakchen" Betty (Jutta Speidel). Although it might be the last opportunity, the strict Hiltrud shows little willingness to develop with Betty, whose lifestyle as a householder and secret woman of the late landlord Heinrich Verhoeven (Benjamin Sadler) will deeply loathe her. He is responsible for the unmarried Hiltrud for the life that her fiance, Heinrich's young brother Franz (Anton Rubsov), fell in the First World War. The former headmistress cannot forgive her sister Betty that in a trial in the 1950s she had to make a serious false statement to defend the family's reputation. Hiltrud's icy hard hard also burdened the MARTHA relationship, which she was leaving alone in important situations. When the students Annekatrin (Anke Retzlaff) and Ira (Victoria Schulz) interview the trio for a short film in front of the camera, old wounds open again. Over all quarrels, women combine to blame for a decades of dead, which they have to face. / Auf dem niederrheinischen Gutshof Verhoeven kommen im Jahr 1994 die drei Janssen-Schwestern zusammen, um den 100. Geburtstag der Ältesten zu feiern. Die Jubilarin Hiltrud (Hildegard Schmahl) ist jedoch alles andere als freiwillig angereist. Ihre zwei Jahre jungere Schwester Martha (Gertrud Roll) mochte erzwingen, dass sie nach Jahrzehnten der Funkstelle wieder mit dem inzwischen 84-jahrigen "Nesthakchen" Betty (Jutta Speidel) spricht. Obwohl es vielleicht die letzte Gelegenheit sein konnte, zeigt die strenge Hiltrud wenig Bereitschaft, sich mit Betty auszusohnen, deren Lebensstil als Haushalterin und heimliche Frau des verstorbenen Gutsherrn Heinrich Verhoeven (Benjamin Sadler) sie zutiefst verabscheut. Ihn macht die zeitlebens unverheiratete Hiltrud dafur verantwortlich, dass ihr Verlobter, Heinrichs jungerer Bruder Franz (Anton Rubtsov), im Ersten Weltkrieg gefallen ist. Ihrer Schwester Betty kann die ehemalige Schulleiterin nicht verzeihen, dass sie bei einem Prozess in den 1950er Jahren eine folgenschwere Falschaussage machen musste, um das Ansehen der Familie zu verteidigen. Hiltruds eisige Harte belastet auch das Verhaltnis zu Martha, die sich von ihr in wichtigen Situationen alleingelassen fuhlte. Als die Studentinnen Annekatrin (Anke Retzlaff) und Ira (Victoria Schulz) das Trio fur einen Kurzfilm vor der Kamera interviewen, brechen alten Wunden wieder auf. Über alle Streitereien hinweg verbindet die Frauen eine jahrzehntelang totgeschwiegene Schuld, der sie sich nun stellen mussen.

programme.title: Hubert and Staller / Hubert und Staller
programme.desc: Hubert and Staller are witnessing a petrol station. The Rauber can flee, but the case seems to be drawn quickly: the DNA traces at the scene belong to Heiko Martens. There is only one problem: the man is dead! Martens was reported to be missing after a boat huck. And only officially explained for deceased for a short time. The grieving widow Sabine Jager-Martens hopes that her husband could still live. The Sister of the dead, Roswitha Martens, follows his very own theory: her brother Sabine wanted to kill Heiko, who was indebted, to get his life insurance at the time, but her attempt failed. Now her brother has returned to throat and prevent the money from paying out. Hubert and Staller suspect that the couple played off: Heiko wanted to get rid of his debts and only exchanged his death. Now he is back to sack life insurance with his wife. The two watch a meeting of the widow with a mysterious man. Is it Heiko? But when Hubert and Staller record the persecution, he escapes again. Then a determined video recording reveals: It is not the dead man that has caught the petrol station, but his sister! Has she exchanged, Heiko was still living so that the brother -in -law ends empty? But that doesn't make any sense. Because Roswitha continues to assert that her brother has her brother on her conscience, as the boat on which Martens is supposed to have a crash on is brought into play, Hubert and Staller have to ask whether the dead sister is not right ... / Hubert und Staller werden Zeugen eines Tankstellenuberfalls. Der Rauber kann fliehen, doch der Fall scheint schnell gelost: Die DNA-Spuren am Tatort gehoren zu Heiko Martens. Es gibt nur ein Problem: Der Mann ist tot! Martens wurde nach einem Bootsungluck als vermisst gemeldet und erst kurzlich offiziell fur verstorben erklart. Die trauernde Witwe Sabine Jager-Martens hegt Hoffnung, dass ihr Mann noch leben konnte. Die Schwester des Toten, Roswitha Martens, verfolgt eine ganz eigene Theorie: Ihre Schwagerin Sabine wollte den verschuldeten Heiko damals auf dem Boot umbringen, um an seine Lebensversicherung zu kommen, doch ihr Versuch schlug fehl. Jetzt ist ihr Bruder zuruckgekehrt, um sich zu rachen und die Auszahlung des Geldes zu verhindern. Hubert und Staller vermuten dahinter ein abgekartetes Spiel des Ehepaars: Heiko wollte seine Schulden loswerden und hat seinen Tod nur vorgetauscht. Nun ist er zuruck, um mit seiner Frau die Lebensversicherung einzusacken. Die beiden beobachten ein Treffen der Witwe mit einem mysteriosen Mann. Handelt es sich um Heiko? Doch als Hubert und Staller die Verfolgung aufnehmen, entkommt er erneut. Dann offenbart eine entschlusselte Videoaufzeichnung: Nicht der Tote hat die Tankstelle uberfallen, sondern seine Schwester! Hat sie vorgetauscht, Heiko wurde noch leben, damit die Schwagerin leer ausgeht? Doch so ganz ergibt das keinen Sinn. Denn Roswitha beteuert nach wie vor, dass ihre Schwagerin ihren Bruder auf dem Gewissen hat.Als dann auch noch das Boot, auf dem Martens verungluckt sein soll, ins Spiel gebracht wird, mussen sich Hubert und Staller fragen, ob die Schwester des Toten nicht doch recht hat ...

programme.title: Murder in the north / Morden im Norden
programme.desc: Finn and Lars are pursuing a sports car, the driver of which is apparently minor year. The boy suddenly loses control over the car and accidentally loses. After the surprising death of his singing and life partner Charles, the celebrated musician has lost all drive power: he no longer wants to compose, no longer get up and no longer eat. Only his neighbor grief around him, the widowed surgeon Nicolaus Roeder (Peter Sattmann). In order to finally get Harry out of his depression, he gets him to hire Rosa as a householder. Kurzum, Chaos an allen Ecken und Enden. In dieser Situation scheint es wie eine gluckliche Fugung, als Rosa durch einen Zufall den exzentrischen Schlagerstar Harry Hansen (Helmut Berger) vom beruhmten "Hansen-Duo" kennenlernt. Nach dem uberraschenden Tod seines Gesangs- und Lebenspartners Charles hat der gefeierte Musiker jegliche Antriebskraft verloren: Er will nicht mehr komponieren, nicht mehr aufstehen und nicht mehr essen. Einzig sein Nachbar kummert sich um ihn, der verwitwete Chirurg Nicolaus Roeder (Peter Sattmann). Um Harry endlich aus seiner Depression herauszureiSSen, drangt er ihn, Rosa als Haushalterin einzustellen. Zwar kommt es zwischen dem launenhaften Kunstler und der unbekummerten Kochin zu so manchen Reibereien. Mit ihrer herzlichen Art gelingt es Rosa jedoch, frischen Wind in Harrys Villa zu bringen und seine Lebensgeister zu aktivieren. Auch ihre beste Freundin Anastasia (Eva Pflug) ist von Rosas neuem Job hellauf begeistert, gehort sie doch zu den groSSten Fans des "Hansen-Duos". Und Rosa selbst scheint in Nicolaus einen charmanten Verehrer zu finden. Dann aber taucht Vivien (Barbara Philipp) auf, die in Neuseeland lebende Zwillingsschwester des verstorbenen Charles. Einst hatte sie sich mit ihrem Bruder zerstritten; nun gibt sie vor, an seinem Grab ihren Frieden mit ihm schlieSSen und endlich seinen Lebenspartner kennenlernen zu wollen. Wahrend Harry sich von Viviens nostalgischen Geschichten uber Charles den Kopf verdrehen lasst, ahnt Rosa, dass Vivien nicht mit offenen Karten spielt. Irgendetwas scheint an der Geschichte uber ihre kranke Tochter, die dringend eine teure Operation benotigt, nicht zu stimmen. Gemeinsam mit Nicolaus macht Rosa sich daran, Licht in die Sache zu bringen.

Doch nachdem im Juli 2020 durch einen Steinschlag Menschen verletzt und getotet wurden, blieb der Weg durch die Klamm fur lange Zeit geschlossen. Umfangreiche SicherungsmaSSnahmen, fur die vorausschauend weitere Felsen abgesprengt wurden, fuhrten letztlich zur praktisch vollstandigen Erneuerung der Steiganlage. Ein Film von Wolfgang Scherz.

programme.title: Summer discussion 2025 / Sommergesprache 2025

programme.desc: Domestic policy chief Klaus Webhofer for the first time leads through the interview series. The "Summer Talks 25" with the chairpersons of the parliament represented in the parliament can be seen this year from August 11th to September 8th, every Monday, at 9:00 p.m. in ORF 2 and on ORF ON. The setting has been the ORF media campus on Kuniglberg for the first time since 2022. Austria's domestic landscape has changed fundamentally in the course of this year. There have been numerous roles at the top of the parliamentary parties. SPÖ chairman Andreas Babler has again taken the party to a federal government despite a National Council election, which was excusing the Social Democrats. He has been a vice -chancellor since Marz and is responsible for the resorts living, art, culture, media and sport. programme.title: Fascination Europe (5) - between city and country / Faszination Europa (5) - Zwischen Stadt und Land
programme.desc: Of the white miracles in the icy north, in the ice cream bar, whales and bearded owl of the clinking cold, far in the warm suds, where the spectacular landscapes offer sneaking cats, flamingos and Berberkaffen: The universe series Fascination Europe provides new insights into the amazing, diverse nature worlds of our continent. As a result, director Christian Baumeister celebrates the wild sides of human civilization in Europe. Deep under Paris, the "City of Love", the once demonized rats in the sewers organize a real party, while in Portugal a bat palace guard protects the knowledge of many centuries. In Carnies, Sperber chasing the many sparrows that are attracted by a farm, and Gewaxhauser and Gluhwurmchen shine in the Netherlands. This film shows how wild animals conquered urban rooms and people cultivated by humans and use them for. Fascination Europe: A unique series about the many natural wonder of Europe from the award -winning director Christian Baumeister. / Von den weiSSen Wunderwelten im eisigen Norden, in dem Eisbaren, Wale und Bartkauze der klirrenden Kalte trotzen, bis weit in den warmen Suden, wo die spektakularen Landschaften Schleichkatzen, Flamingos und Berberaffen Ruckzugsorte bieten: Die UNIVERSUM-Serie FASZINATION EUROPA liefert neue Einblicke in die erstaunlichen, vielfaltigen Naturwelten unseres Kontinents. In der Folge ZWISCHEN STADT UND LAND zelebriert Regisseur Christian Baumeister die wilden Seiten der menschlichen Zivilisation in Europa. Tief unter Paris, der "Stadt der Liebe", veranstalten die einst verteufelten Ratten in den Abwasserkanalen eine regelrechte Party, wahrend in Portugal eine Fledermaus-Palastwache das Wissen vieler Jahrhunderte schutzt. In Karnten jagen Sperber die vielen Sperlinge, die von einem Bauernhof angezogen werden, und in den Niederlanden leuchten Gewachshauser und Gluhwurmchen um die Wette. Dieser Film zeigt, wie Wildtiere auf uberraschende Weise urbane Raume und vom Menschen kultivierte Gebiete erobern und diese fur sich nutzen. FASZINATION EUROPA: Eine einzigartige Serie uber die vielen Naturwunder Europas vom preisgekronten Regisseur Christian Baumeister.

programme.title: Remark times! - Johann-Philipps Castle visits / Herrschaftszeiten! - Johann-Philipps Schlossbesuche
programme.sub-title: Bei Famile Almásy auf Burg Bernstein
programme.desc: After the successful start of the new series "Rulance!" At Tratzberg Castle in Tyrol-up to half a million viewers followed the premiere-this time neo-moderator Johann-Philipp Spiegelfeld visited Bernstein Castle in Burgenland. The 40-year-old historian, who is in the actual bread profession Aua flight capitan and in his leisure time, now spends two days with the Almásy family in their imposing residence. Some may already be known to some that a "white woman" should drive around and that the film "The English Patient" - born here - the Lászlo Almásy born here - is about 9 Oscars. But many other secrets and stories about the historical property, the owners and the picturesque environment can be experienced thanks to the immortal desire of the guest Johann-Philipp Spiegelfeld. The Bernstein Castle is located in the border area of ​​Lower Austria, the STMK and the BGLD, 11km north of Bad Tatzmannsdorf, has been mentioned for the first time in 1236, has been owned for the first time since 1892, has been owned by the Almásy family since 1892 40 rooms on 8000m2 and in a few of these rooms that are of course furnished with original furniture can also live as a hotel guest. Ubrigen is fed in a Renaissance -style hall from 1580 - without electricity, by candlelight. / Nach dem erfolgreichen Start der neuen Reihe "Herrschaftszeiten!" auf Schloss Tratzberg in Tirol - bis zu einer halben Million ZuseherInnen verfolgten die Premiere - besucht Neo-Moderator Johann-Philipp Spiegelfeld diesmal die Burg Bernstein im Burgenland.Der 40jahrige studierte Historiker, der im eigentlichen Brotberuf AUA-Flugkapitan und in seiner Freizeit Malteser-Rettungssanitater ist, verbringt nun zwei Tage bei Familie Almásy in deren imposanten Wohnsitz. Dass sich in der Burg eine "WeiSSe Frau" herumtreiben soll und dass der mit 9 Oscars gekronte Film "Der englische Patient" von einem Vorfahren der heutigen Besitzer - dem hier geborenen Lászlo Almásy - handelt, mag manchen bereits bekannt sein. Aber viele weitere Geheimnisse und Geschichten rund um das geschichtstrachtige Anwesen, die Besitzer und die malerische Umgebung erfahrt man dank der unermudlichen Wissbegierde des Gastes Johann-Philipp Spiegelfeld.Die Burg Bernstein liegt im Grenzgebiet von NÖ, der Stmk und dem Bgld, 11km nordlich von Bad Tatzmannsdorf, wurde 1236 erstmals urkundlich erwahnt, ist seit 1892 im Besitz der Familie Almásy, hat 40 Zimmer auf 8000m2 und in einigen wenigen dieser Zimmer, die naturlich mit originalen Mobeln eingerichtet sind, kann jedermann auch als Hotelgast wohnen. Gespeist wird ubrigens in einem Saal im Renaissance-Stil aus dem Jahr 1580 - ohne Strom, bei Kerzenlicht.

programme.title: crisscross / kreuz und quer
programme.desc: She was a simple Jewish girl and came from a village that is not even mentioned in the Old Testament - from Nazareth. programme.title: Culture today / Kultur Heute
programme.desc: The week kick -off with Mercedes. She looks back at 20 years of hiking cinema - a project that has brought the magic of cinema directly to people for two decades. Uber speaks about the idea of ​​making culture mobile and low -threshold, and about the challenges and successes of this special cultural initiative. / Wochenauftakt mit Mercedes EchererZum Wochenauftakt ist die Schauspielerin und Moderatorin Mercedes Echerer im Studio zu Gast. Sie blickt zuruck auf 20 Jahre Wanderkino - ein Projekt, das den Zauber des Kinos seit zwei Jahrzehnten direkt zu den Menschen bringt. Echerer spricht uber die Idee, Kultur mobil und niederschwellig erlebbar zu machen, und uber die Herausforderungen und Erfolge dieser besonderen Kulturinitiative.

programme.title: WETTER/INFO / WETTER/INFO
Land of the mountains / Land der Berge
programme.sub-title: Das magische Maggiatal: Klare Bergseen und majestatische Gipfel
programme.desc: Hans Jochler is traveling in the magical Maggiatal in Switzerland in this visual "Land of Mountain" production. The mixture of alpine beautiful and Mediterranean flair makes the Maggiatal a unique background place. The idyllic places, in a wonderful location between mountains and water, have attracted artists since the 20th century. In Ascona, the climatic health resort of Ascona with its inviting lake promenade you can experience the messenger of the spring up close. The impressive "Holy Mountain" Madonna del Sasso, a place of pilgrimage on a rock lead with a breathtaking view over the lake, allows an insight behind its historical and spiritual walls. Apart from the moon banks of the Lago Maggiore, the wild, beautiful Alps reveals itself, which offer a unique setting for small towns such as Bignasco. From historical straw roofers in Onsernone to modern architectural wonders in Mogno - "Land of the Mountains" immerse yourself in the diverse culture and history of the Maggiatal and portrays one of the most beautiful regions in Switzerland. / In dieser bildgewaltigen "Land der Berge"-Produktion ist Hans Jochler im magischen Maggiatal in der Schweiz unterwegs. Die Mischung aus alpiner Schonheit und mediterranem Flair macht das Maggiatal zu einem einzigartigen Ruckzugsort. Die idyllischen Orte, in herrlicher Lage zwischen Bergen und Wasser, ziehen seit dem 20. Jahrhundert Kunstlerinnen und Kunstler an.Im Luftkurort Ascona mit seiner einladenden Seepromenade kann man die Boten des Fruhlings hautnah miterleben. Der beeindruckende "heilige Berg" Madonna del Sasso, ein Wallfahrtsort auf einem Felsvorsprung mit atemberaubendem Blick uber den See, erlaubt Einblicke hinter seine geschichtstrachtigen und spirituellen Mauern. Abseits der mondanen Ufer des Lago Maggiore offenbart sich die wilde Schonheit der Tessiner Alpen, die eine einzigartige Kulisse fur kleine Ortschaften wie Bignasco bieten. Von historischen Strohdachern in Onsernone bis zu modernen Architekturwundern in Mogno - "Land der Berge" taucht ein in die vielfaltige Kultur und Geschichte des Maggiatals und portraitiert eine der schonsten Regionen der Schweiz.

programme.title: Hermann Maier: My home - the Montafon / Hermann Maier: Meine Heimat - Das Montafon
programme.desc: The higher the mountains, the more colorful and varied fauna and flora, the bigger the chance to find Hermann Maier there. For "universe" he goes again on a journey of discovery through his homeland. This time he explores the impressive mountains and the species-rich plant and fauna of the Montafon in Vorarlberg. The water -rich valley in the Sudosten of Vorarlberg is a popular destination for skiers, attracts hikers to the variety of alpine pastures, as well as climbers and climbers to striking peaks, such as the legendary Piz Buin (highest mountain Vorarlbergs) in the silvretta area. Hermann Maier will also discover the less well -known but no less interesting sides of the region and for his viewers. So he starts looking for amphibians such as grass frosche and lizards, looking for rare insects such as the butterfly on the romantic cornasses (pre -alms), but of course also the typical animals of high alpine mountains such as ibex, bearded vulture or snow chickens. / Je hoher die Berge, je bunter und abwechslungsreicher Fauna und Flora, umso groSSer die Chance, dort auch Hermann Maier anzutreffen. Fur "Universum" geht er ein weiteres Mal auf Entdeckungsreise durch seine Heimat. Diesmal erkundet er die eindrucksvolle Bergwelt und die artenreiche Pflanzen- und Tierwelt des Montafon in Vorarlberg. Das wasserreiche Tal im Sudosten Vorarlbergs ist ein beliebtes Ziel fur Skifahrer, lockt Wanderer auf die vielzahligen Almen, ebenso Bergsteiger und Kletterer auf markante Gipfel, wie den sagenumwobenen Piz Buin (hochster Berg Vorarlbergs) im Silvrettagebiet. Hermann Maier wird auch die weniger bekannten, aber nicht minder interessanten Seiten der Region mit und fur seine Zuschauer entdecken. So macht er sich auf die Suche nach Amphibien wie Grasfrosche und Eidechsen, sucht nach seltenen Insekten wie dem Schmetterlingshaft auf den romantischen MaisaSSen (Voralmen), erspaht aber naturlich auch die typischen Tiere hochalpiner Bergregionen wie Steinbock, Bartgeier oder auch Schneehuhner.

programme.title: Harrys liabste Huttn / Harrys liabste Huttn
programme.desc: In addition to lots of natural experiences, Harry Prunster around Zell am See also expect cultural surprises. On the 4-Seen-Kunstweg you get to the Schmittenhöhe, the Zeller local mountain. Under the motto "Art on the Mountain" Saumen 26 oversized sculptures the way to the summit. Previously, Harry visits the Areitalm, which is managed by Peter and Edith Pfeffer. Peter Ladt Harry in a round on the trial machine and a glass of Weesburgunder in his vinotheque. Ernst Steger serves a costly game dish on the Sonnkogelhutte. Before the passionate Huttenwirt was taken over the alpine pasture nine years ago, he was an electrician, one of the next tarpaulin is the construction of a bar. Harry climbs the MS Schmittenhohe of the shipping center in Zell am See. Marco Voglreiter works here, on the Sundeck Lounge he serves Harry a refreshment and classifies him on the ship on Friday evening. / Neben jeder Menge Naturerlebnissen erwarten Harry Prunster rund um Zell am See auch kulturelle Überraschungen. Auf dem 4-Seen-Kunstweg gelangt man zur Schmittenhohe, den Zeller Hausberg. Unter dem Motto "Kunst am Berg" saumen 26 uberdimensionale Skulpturen den Weg auf den Gipfel. Zuvor besucht Harry die Areitalm, die von Peter und Edith Pfeffer bewirtschaftet wird. Peter ladt Harry zu einer Runde auf der Trialmaschine und zu einem Glas Weissburgunder in seine Vinothek ein. Auf der Sonnkogelhutte serviert Wirt Ernst Steger ein kostliches Wildgericht. Ehe der leidenschaftliche Huttenwirt vor neun Jahren die Alm ubernahm war er Elektriker, einer der nachsten Plane ist der Bau einer Bar.An der Schiffanlegestelle in Zell am See besteigt Harry die MS Schmittenhohe. Hier arbeitet Marco Voglreiter, auf der Sundeck Lounge serviert er Harry eine Erfrischung und ladt ihn zum Freitagabend Tanz am Schiff ein.

programme.title: Harrys liabste Huttn / Harrys liabste Huttn
programme.desc: Harry Prunster is on the Styrian side of Semmering and visits a very special hat at the beginning of his hike: the Seewirtshaus was built in 1666 and 333 years later was revealed by Christian Riess at the new location. He paid for the idea and the move of the Styrian farmhouse to the small lake on the Semmering. It is managed by Sepp and Brigitte Filwieser and a speciality is the trout that have been breeded by a neighboring farmer for some time. At Karl Lechner Haus, an Alpine club hat, Harry meets Gunter Stifter, who has been here for 36 years. Traditional home cooking such as roast pork from the wood stove, lentils with bacon or pea soup is served. Harry's last stop is the Alois Gunther Haus, also an Alpine club spellte that was recently overwhelmed by Roland Hummer. He has been in the gastronomy for 30 years, both abroad and hutten and made first place in 1988 at the professional Olympics in Sydney as the best waiter. In addition to Styrian food, there are also funny burger creations such as the 1782 burger, the Green Magic Burger or the Magic Mountain Burger. / Auf der steirischen Seite des Semmering ist Harry Prunster unterwegs und besucht zu Beginn seiner Wanderung eine ganz besondere Hutte: Das Seewirtshaus wurde 1666 erbaut und 333 Jahre spater vom Christian Riess am neuen Standort wiedereroffnet. Er erzahlt von der Idee und der Übersiedlung des steirischen Bauernhauses an den kleinen See am Semmering.Am Stuhleck kehrt Harry in der Friedrichhutte ein; sie wird von Sepp und Brigitte Filzwieser bewirtschaftet und eine Spezialitat sind die Forellen, die seit einiger Zeit von einem benachbarten Bauern wieder gezuchtet werden. Am Karl Lechner Haus, einer Alpenvereinshutte, trifft Harry auf Gunter Stifter der seit 36 Jahren hier tatig ist. Serviert wird traditionelle Hausmannskost wie Schweinsbraten aus dem Holzofen, Linsen mit Speck oder Erbsensuppe. Harrys letzte Station ist das Alois Gunther Haus, ebenfalls eine Alpenvereinshutte, das vor kurzem von Roland Hummer ubernommen wurde. Er ist seit 30 Jahren in der Gastronomie tatig, sowohl im Ausland als auch auf Hutten und hat 1988 bei der Berufsolympiade in Sydney als bester Kellner den ersten Platz gemacht. Neben steirischer Kost gibt es auch witzige Burger Kreationen, wie den 1782er Burger, den Green Magic Burger oder den Magic Mountain Burger.

programme.title: Harrys liabste Huttn / Harrys liabste Huttn
programme.desc: This time Harry Prunster is doing a funny hiking and driving tour with unusual means of transportation through the blue-ranking wine region. The Segway to Frankenau, the Csarda by Sonja and Peter Leidl from the center in Grossmutschen. The old stretch yard is over 100 years old, today's dining room served as a stable for the farm animals. There are currently mushroom dishes on the menu, but also regional dishes such as Langos, Griessterz and Solmnauer Nockerln. Harry reaches the next Buschenschank in Lutzmannsburg with the tractor from Wirt Gunther Plochl. He took the company from his parents in the 1990s, and the winery itself has been around since the 16th century. Part of the wine is served, but the majority are delivered to the catering business. Here Miriam Perkovits manages a restaurant with old Vienna names that "Dere" that she opened in 2000 together with a friend and offered stilts and pawns as specialty. / Harry Prunster macht diesmal eine lustige Wander- und Fahrtour mit ungewohnlichen Fortbewegungsmitteln durch die Blaufrankische Weinregion. Vom Mittelpunktstein in GroSSmutschen geht es mit dem Segway nach Frankenau, in die Csarda von Sonja und Peter Leidl. John Kunkle, who always has one or the other saying ready. programme.title: Mom's cake K1 E17 (E) / Η Τούρτα της Μαμάς Κ1 Ε17 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Kamena Vourla, Part A. programme.title: Charlie's Angels / Οι Άγγελοι του Τσάρλι
programme.desc: Sampina, Elena, and Jane work for the mysterious Mr. Charlie Townsend. Having at his service the smartest, brave and well -trained women in the world, Charlie guides his angels to the most demanding missions. (120) / Η Σαμπίνα, η Έλενα, και η Τζέιν δουλεύουν για τον μυστηριώδη κύριο Τσάρλι Τάουνσεντ. Έχοντας στην υπηρεσία του τις πιο έξυπνες, γενναίες και άρτια εκπαιδευμένες γυναίκες στον κόσμο, ο Τσάρλι καθοδηγεί τους Αγγέλους του στις πιο απαιτητικές αποστολές. (120)

programme.title: The time machine (e) / Η Μηχανή του Χρόνου (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Happiness Papayannopoulou. The adventurous life of the great lyricist, who broke the male establishment in folk song. Research illuminates her life, from childhood in Asia Minor and the traumatic experience of persecution and refugee to her career in Athens. / Επεισόδιο: Ευτυχία Παπαγιαννοπούλου. Η περιπετειώδης ζωή της μεγάλης στιχουργού, που έσπασε το ανδρικό κατεστημένο στο λαϊκό τραγούδι. Η έρευνα φωτίζει τη ζωή της, από τα παιδικά χρόνια στη Μικρά Ασία και την τραυματική εμπειρία του διωγμού και της προσφυγιάς, ως την πορεία της στην Αθήνα.

programme.title: Studio 4 (E) / Στούντιο 4 (Ε)
programme.desc: Nancy Zambetoglou and Thanassis Anagnostopoulos are returning for the fifth year to talk about everything that concerns us, inspire, entertain us or move us. / H Νάνσυ Ζαμπέτογλου και ο Θανάσης Αναγνωστόπουλος επιστρέφουν για πέμπτη χρονιά για να μιλήσουν για όλα όσα μας απασχολούν, μας εμπνέουν, μας διασκεδάζουν ή μας συγκινούν.

programme.title: Hercules Poirot's Adventures (E) / Οι Περιπέτειες του Ηρακλή Πουαρό (Ε)
programme.desc: Award-winning English-produced 2000-2006 series, based on Agatha Christie's police novels and short stories with her beloved enigmatic, eccentric and extremely intelligent famous detective Hercules Poirot. / Βραβευμένη σειρά Αγγλικής παραγωγής 2000-2006, βασισμένη στα αστυνομικά μυθιστορήματα και διηγήματα της Άγκαθα Κρίστι με τον αγαπημένο αινιγματικό, εκκεντρικό και εξαιρετικά ευφυή διάσημο ντετέκτιβ Ηρακλή Πουαρό.

programme.title: Traveling with Maya (E) / Ταξιδεύοντας με τη Μάγια (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Guatemala - Part A. Maya Choclis visits Guatemala, the Mayan land, whose culture has experienced its acne from the 3rd to the 8th AD. century. Our journey begins in the river Rio Passion with its tropical forest and continues to the famous Lake Attikn, famous for its beauty. / Επεισόδιο: Γουατεμάλα - Μέρος Α. Η Μάγια Τσόκλη επισκέπτεται τη Γουατεμάλα, τη γη των Μάγια, ο πολιτισμός των οποίων γνώρισε την ακμή του από τον 3ο έως τον 8ο μχ. αιώνα. Το ταξίδι μας ξεκινά μέσα στον ποταμό Ρίο Πασιόν με το τροπικό του δάσος και συνεχίζει στη διάσημη λίμνη Αττιτλάν που φημίζεται για την ομορφιά της.

programme.title: Traveling with Maya (E) / Ταξιδεύοντας με τη Μάγια (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Guatemala - Part B. The second part, begins in Rio Passion, in the footsteps of the commercial roads of Emerald and Salt starting from the Caribbean. An unexpected route within the rainforest leads to the archaeological site of Seibal that once was a center of astronomy. / Επεισόδιο: Γουατεμάλα - Μέρος Β. Το δεύτερο μέρος, ξεκινά μέσα στο Ρίο Πασιόν, στα βήματα των εμπορικών δρόμων του σμαραγδιού και του αλατιού που ξεκινούσαν από τη Καραϊβική. Μία απρόσμενη διαδρομή μέσα στο τροπικό δάσος οδηγεί στον αρχαιολογικό χώρο του Σειμπάλ που υπήρξε κάποτε και κέντρο αστρονομίας.

programme.title: The E2 Time Machine (E) / Η Μηχανή του Χρόνου Ε2 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Sotiris Moustakas. Unknown stories from the life and artistic course of Sotiris Moustakas, from his youth in Cyprus, Athens and in his career in cinema and theater. / Επεισόδιο: Σωτήρης Μουστάκας. Άγνωστες ιστορίες από τη ζωή και την καλλιτεχνική πορεία του Σωτήρη Μουστάκα, από τα νεανικά του χρόνια στην Κύπρο, στην Αθήνα και στην πορεία του στον κινηματογράφο και το θέατρο.

programme.title: Life otherwise K2 E6 (E) / Η Ζωή Αλλιώς Κ2 Ε6 (Ε)

The La Macarena National Park, in the heart of Colombia, hosts one of the most beautiful rivers in the world: Kano Cristals and a completely unique fauna and flora. / Επεισόδιο: Ο Ποταμός Κάνιο Κριστάλες. Το Εθνικό Πάρκο La Macarena, στην καρδιά της Κολομβίας, φιλοξενεί έναν από τους πιο όμορφους ποταμούς στον κόσμο: τον Κάνιο Κριστάλες και μία εντελώς μοναδική πανίδα και χλωρίδα.

programme.title: Contemporary Traditional E10 Music (E) / Σύγχρονη Παραδοσιακή Μουσική Ε10 (Ε)
programme.desc: Hebrew scales. The aim of the band Evrikis Zygia is to rescue, reproduce and highlight anecdotal songs from western, eastern and northern Thrace, with the style and sound surrendered by the earliest generations of musicians. / Εβρίτικη Ζυγιά. Στόχος του συγκροτήματος Εβρίτικη Ζυγιά είναι η διάσωση, αναπαραγωγή και ανάδειξη ανέκδοτων τραγουδιών από τη Δυτική, Ανατολική και Βόρεια Θράκη, με το ύφος και ηχόχρωμα που παρέδωσαν οι παλαιότερες γενιές μουσικών.

programme.title: Ephesus and Psalm E4 (E) / Όψον και Ψαλμός Ε4 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Riganoches and sweet rhizopita. A new series of delicious cooking documentaries, with the care of Elder Epiphanios filmed exclusively on Mount Athos by filmmaker Chroni Pechlivanidis. / Επεισόδιο: Ριγανοκεφτέδες και ριζόπιτα γλυκιά. Νέα σειρά ντοκιμαντέρ εύγευστων μαγειρικών συνταγών, με τη φροντίδα του γέροντα Επιφάνιου γυρισμένη αποκλειστικά στο Άγιον Όρος από τον κινηματογραφιστή Χρόνη Πεχλιβανίδη.

programme.title: Perimeter (e) / Περίμετρος (Ε)
programme.desc: An informative broadcast that focuses daily on the news and on specific issues, in concentric circles, with a focus on Thessaloniki, the regions of the country, our neighboring countries and the community. / Ενημερωτική εκπομπή η οποία επικεντρώνει καθημερινά στην επικαιρότητα και σε ειδικά θέματα, σε ομόκεντρους κύκλους, με έμφαση τη Θεσσαλονίκη, τις περιφέρειες της χώρας, τις γειτονικές μας χώρες και την Ομογένεια.

programme.title: Our E4 Farm (E) / Η Δική μας Φάρμα Ε4 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Pulsea exhibitions and pigs. Holger and Peter horse breeders are anxious: Will Santa Grasia be able to persuade the critics at the Poulon Exhibition? The pigman is experiencing the first birth of little pigs. A great day for the whole family! / Επεισόδιο: Εκθέσεις Πουλαριών και Γεννητούρια Γουρουνιών. Οι εκτροφείς αλόγων Χόλγκερ και Πέτερ έχουν άγχος: Θα μπορέσει το πουλάρι Σάντα Γκρασία να πείσει τους κριτές στην έκθεση πουλαριών; Η χοιροτρόφος Κάτι βιώνει την πρώτη γέννα μικρών γουρουνιών. Μια μεγάλη μέρα για όλη την οικογένεια!

programme.title: Every place and song K2 (e) / Κάθε Τόπος και Τραγούδι Κ2 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Paxos all! Dances, songs, narratives and many historianographic elements make up an approach to the particular Western -style music and dance style of Paxos. / Επεισόδιο: Παξοί ολούθε! Χοροί, τραγούδια , αφηγήσεις και πολλά ιστορικογεωγραφικά στοιχεία συνθέτουν μία προσέγγιση του ιδιαίτερου δυτικότροπου μουσικοχορευτικού ύφους των Παξών.

programme.title: My trip to Greece K5 E11 (E) / Το Ταξίδι μου στην Ελλάδα Κ5 Ε11 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: From Amorgos to Ios. Returning to Amorgos, Peter Manea tests some of the best eaten, explores the beaches of the island, and learns about local history. Then, it sails for Ios, the island of fun ... and not only. / Επεισόδιο: Από την Αμοργό στην Ίο. Έπειτα, σαλπάρει για την Ίο, το νησί της διασκέδασης... και όχι μόνο.

programme.title: The Diary of Nature E2 (E) / Το Ημερολόγιο της Φύσης Ε2 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: February. A few months are more welcome than others, but in the diary of nature there is always something to be thrilled. Μερικοί μήνες είναι πιο ευπρόσδεκτοι από άλλους, αλλά στο ημερολόγιο της φύσης υπάρχει πάντα κάτι να ενθουσιαστείτε. Ο Φεβρουάριος είναι ένας μήνας αντιφάσεων, όπου θα κάνει πολύ ζέστη για κάποιους και πολύ κρύο για τους άλλους.

programme.desc: Episode: The Bisagos Archipelago. programme.title: Greece's borders E9 (E) / Τα Σύνορα της Ελλάδας Ε9 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: The Dodecanese. After a long period of Frankish rule, the Dodecanese passed into the hands of the Ottomans and then to those of the Italians. Ήταν μόλις το 1947, μετά την ήττα της Ιταλίας στον Β Παγκόσμιο, που τα νησιά ενώθηκαν με την Ελλάδα.

programme.title: Islands on the edge E4 (e) / Νησιά στην Άκρη Ε4 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Fisherman. Psara is an island that once passed by the disaster. But it turned out to be alive and durable over time. programme.title: Kant, the experiment of freedom / Καντ, το Πείραμα της Ελευθερίας
programme.desc: PREMIERE. The film presents Kant's place of origin, Kenigsburg, bringing us to the 18th century using advanced animation techniques and re -raises the questions that were employed by the world 300 years ago. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Η ταινία παρουσιάζει τον τόπο καταγωγής του Καντ, το Κένιγκσμπεργκ, μεταφέροντάς μας στον 18ο αιώνα με τη χρήση προηγμένων τεχνικών κινούμενης εικόνας και θέτει εκ νέου τα ερωτήματα που απασχολούσαν τον κόσμο 300 χρόνια πριν.

programme.title: Out of lines E3 (E) / Έξω από τις Γραμμές Ε3 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: The Tree of Violence - Russia. Την τελευταία δεκαετία, η καλλιτέχνις Βικτώρια Λομάσκο έχει αφιερώσει τη ζωή της στη λεπτομερή καταγραφή της Ρωσίας του Πούτιν και τη βαθιά εξερεύνηση των περίπλοκων συνδέσεων μεταξύ της ενδοοικογενειακής βίας και της κρατικής βίας.

programme.title: A hero / Ένας Ήρωας

Αλλά και οι υπόλοιποι αγρότες αντιμετωπίζουν δυσκολίες.
