programme.title: News / Telejornal
programme.desc: The most rigorous news selection every day at 20h00. From Monday to Sunday, Joao Adelino Faria, Jose Rodrigues dos Santos and Ana Lourenço show him the most relevant country and in the world. If it is important is on the newscast. / A mais rigorosa seleçao de notícias, todos os dias às 20h00. De segunda a domingo, Joao Adelino Faria, Jose Rodrigues dos Santos e Ana Lourenço mostram-lhe o que de mais relevante se passou o país e no mundo. Se e importante está no Telejornal.

programme.title: Felp / Felp
programme.desc: A doll and mysteriously kidnapped at the door of a coffee, raising suspicions about a possible vacancy of violence against dolls. Meanwhile, engineer Isabel Lima, a powerful leader of the Tapamin, publicly guarantees her support to the hairy community, while behind the scenes tensions and manipulations begin to draw the contours of a much larger fight. / Um boneco e raptado misteriosamente à porta de um cafe, levantando suspeitas sobre uma possível vaga de violencia contra bonecos. Enquanto isso, a Engenheira Isabel Lima, poderosa líder da Tapamisto, garante publicamente o seu apoio à comunidade peluda, enquanto nos bastidores as tensões e manipulações começam a desenhar os contornos de uma luta muito maior.

programme.title: Felp / Felp
programme.desc: The dolls community begins to organize itself in the face of increasing kidnaps. In a makeshift gathering in the laundry, the idea of ​​creating an association is born. Among several suggestions of names, the acronym FELP is born: spectacular front by hairy freedom. Meanwhile, the police are unable to investigate and tension in the city increases. / A comunidade de bonecos começa a organizar-se perante o aumento de raptos. Numa reuniao improvisada na lavandaria, nasce a ideia de criar uma associaçao. Entre várias sugestões de nomes, nasce o acronimo FELP: Frente Espetacular pela Liberdade Peluda. Enquanto isso, a polícia mostra-se pouco motivada a investigar e a tensao na cidade aumenta.

programme.title: Joker / Joker
programme.desc: Vasco Palmeirim presents the Joker, the favorite contest of the Portuguese. A competitor, with the help of 7 jokers and Super Joker, answers 12 questions with one objective in mind: winning the 50 000 euros of the maximum prize! / Vasco Palmeirim apresenta o JOKER, o concurso favorito dos portugueses. Um concorrente, com a ajuda de 7 Jokers e do Super Joker, responde a 12 perguntas com um so objetivo em mente: Conquistar os 50 000 euros do premio máximo!

programme.title: Error 404 / Erro 404
programme.desc: Returning to her life, Rita finds a owner -free CaO, which eventually becomes fond of. Carlota, his boss, gives her a new opportunity and gives her the campaign she wanted so much. / De regresso à sua vida, Rita encontra um cao sem dono, a que acaba por se afeiçoar. Carlota, sua chefe, dá-lhe uma nova oportunidade e devolve-lhe a campanha que ela tanto queria.

programme.title: In addition to the brain / Para Alem do Cerebro
programme.desc: Will we be able to give you what is happening hundreds of meters or even across the world? Or to anticipate the future? In this episode, we approach the concepts of clairvidence and precognition, phenomena that has been the subject of numerous studies over the years. / Seremos capazes de pressentir o que está a acontecer a centenas de metros ou ate mesmo do outro lado do mundo? Ou de antecipar o futuro? Neste episodio, abordamos os conceitos de clarividencia e precogniçao, fenomenos que tem sido alvo de inúmeros estudos ao longo dos anos.

programme.title: Sao Filipe Invites - Fogo Island - CV / Sao Filipe Convida - Ilha do Fogo - CV
programme.desc: A native of Fogo Island, Neuza de Pina has grown surrounded by the musical culture that now shares with the world. His distinct voice and soul-filled interpretations made it one of the greatest representatives of traditional Cape Verdean music. / Natural da ilha do Fogo, Neuza de Pina cresceu rodeada pela cultura musical que agora partilha com o mundo. A sua voz distinta e interpretações cheias de alma tornaram-na uma das maiores representantes da música tradicional cabo-verdiana.

programme.title: Time to act / Hora de Agir
programme.desc: Time to act and a program of the Forum of Energy and Climate that aims to unite the voice of science, politics, companies and civil society from different Portuguese -speaking countries around solutions to overcome the climate crisis. / Hora de Agir e um programa do Forum da Energia e Clima que tem como objetivo unir a voz da ciencia, politica, empresas e sociedade civil dos diferentes países de língua portuguesa em torno das soluções para vencer a Crise Climática.

programme.title: Balacobaco / Balacobaco
programme.desc: Isabel and a successful architect who see her life crumble when she finds out that her husband, Danilo, lost everything in gambling and illegal schemes, besides his sister to die in a mysterious accident, leaving her with the guard of niece Taís. / Isabel e uma arquiteta bem sucedida que ve sua vida ruir quando descobre que seu marido, Danilo, perdeu tudo em jogos de azar e esquemas ilegais, alem de sua irma morrer em um acidente misterioso, deixando-a com a guarda da sobrinha Taís.

programme.title: Argentina Wild / Argentina Selvagem
programme.desc: Whether they are frenters, penguins or sea lions, many sea creatures will give birth to almost 5000 kilometers of Argentina coastal. From the first sigh everything revolves around survival. / Sejam baleias-francas, pinguins ou leões-marinhos, muitas criaturas marinhas vao dar à luz nos quase 5000 quilometros de litoral da Argentina. Desde o primeiro suspiro tudo gira em torno da sobrevivencia.

programme.title: The man of Amália / O Homem da Amália
programme.desc: The story of a man who existed, and ceased to exist for falling in love with a star who could not be achieved. The story of a man who dedicated his life and death after our only diva wherever she was. Through the fados she sang, the verses she wrote, and the passions she felt, let's follow Amália seeing her through the eyes of the man who lived for her, and died for her. In a show full of theater blows, let's get to know the Amália that only this man knew. In the homes of fado, the theaters, in the cinema, the outdoor, the envy inside. Let's remember some things we already knew about her life, and know others she never said. And when the cloth closes, our biggest star will be even more present in our memories, where it has never failed to shine, now sublimated by the ravings of the heartbreak of this unknown Amália man. Celebration show of the 50th career of actor Virgílio Castelo, at the Malaposto Cultural Center. / A historia de um homem que existiu, e deixou de existir, por se ter apaixonado por uma estrela que nao se podia alcançar. A historia de um homem que dedicou a sua vida e a sua morte, a seguir a nossa única diva, onde quer que ela estivesse. Atraves dos fados que ela cantou, dos versos que ela escreveu, e das paixões que sentiu, vamos acompanhar Amália vendo-a atraves dos olhos do homem que por ela viveu, e por ela morreu. Num espetáculo cheio de golpes de teatro, vamos ficar a conhecer a Amália que so este homem conheceu. Nas casas de fado, nos teatros, no cinema, no exito lá fora, na inveja cá dentro. Vamos recordar algumas coisas que já sabíamos da vida dela, e ficar a saber outras de que ela nunca falou. E quando o pano fechar, a nossa estrela maior, estará ainda mais presente nas nossas memorias, onde nunca deixou de brilhar, sublimada, agora, pelos desvarios do coraçao destroçado deste desconhecido Homem da Amália. Espetáculo de comemoraçao dos 50 anos de carreira do ator Virgílio Castelo, no Centro Cultural Malaposta.

programme.title: Martial arts - MMA: Melo Vs Hamou / Borilački sport - MMA: Melo vs Hamou
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Basketball - KLS: FMP - Mega, G2 / Košarka - KLS: FMP - Mega, G2
programme.desc: Serbia has its first basketball league as the highest rank of professional basketball in that country. The League itself was founded in 2006. and as such as 14 teams. The competition takes place according to the subcircular point system and in mutual meetings each club hosts one time and by one guest. It is interesting in this part of the competition, Serbian clubs playing in this part of the competition, which play the regional ABA league. After the first part of the four best clubs are placed in the Super League in which clubs that played a regional competition are placed only then and in that phase, the Champions of Serbia is decided. The number of clubs that will be placed in the Super League depends on the number of representatives in the regional league, but in that part of the competition, there are always 8 teams. / Srbija ima svoju prvu košarkašku ligu kao najviši rang profesionalne košarke u toj zemlji. Sama liga osnovana je 2006. godine i kao takva broji 14 timova. Takmičenje se odvija po dvokružnom bod sistemu te je u međusobnim susretima svaki klub jedan put domaćin i po jednom gost. Zanimljivost je što u ovom delu takmičenja ne nastupaju i srpski klubovi koji igraju regionalnu ABA ligu. Nakon prvog dela četiri najbolja kluba se plasiraju u Superligu u kojoj se tek tada priključuju klubovi koji su igrali regionalno takmičenje i u toj fazi se odlučuje o prvaku Srbije. Broj klubova koji će se plasirati u Superligu zavisi o broju predstavnika u regionalnoj ligi, no u tom delu takmičenja se uvek nalazi 8 timova.

programme.title: They love Serbia / Oni vole Srbiju
programme.desc: The number of players and coaches who found its happiness in Serbia is not small. They belong to different branches of sports, and they could have been convinced here how true the famous Serbian hospitality stories are true. Some of them found the love of your life here, found homes, friends for all life, get citizenship. What is their attitude towards Serbia and what their life is, find out in our show. / Broj igrača i trenera koji je svoju sreću pronašao u Srbiji nije mali. programme.title: Košarka - Euroleague: Panathinaikos - Efes, G1 / Košarka - Euroleague: Panathinaikos - Efes, G1
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

The transition cup intended for the champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana Earth. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. The absolute recorder in the number of favorites achieved is the legend of Varteks Davor Vugrinec with 144 goals. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se menjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prelazni kup namenjen prvaku delo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo. Apsolutni rekorder po broju postignutih pogodaka legenda je Varteksa Davor Vugrinec sa 144 gola.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Final: Partizan - Budućnost, G3 / Košarka - ABA liga: Finale: Partizan - Budućnost, G3
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football: Wwin League BiH: Worker - Velez / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Radnik - Velež
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - Montenegrin League: Future - Decic / Fudbal - Crnogorska liga: Budućnost - Dečić
programme.desc: The Montenegrin football league was founded in 2004. years but the first season was played in 2006/2007. after the independence of the state. 12 Clubs in a three-round system of the competition struggled for the title of the champion, which finally won Zeta from Golubovac, which was the only title of the Champions of Montenegro. Today's number of clubs has been reduced to 10 and plays 30 cars. / Crnogorska fudbalska liga osnovana je 2004. godine ali prva sezona odigrana je u sezoni 2006./2007. nakon osamostaljenja države. 12 klubova se u trokružnom sistemu takmičenja borilo za titulu prvaka koji je na kraju osvojila Zeta iz Golubovaca, kojoj je to ostala jedina titula prvaka Crne Gore. Današnji broj klubova smanjen je na 10 te se igra 30 kola.

programme.title: Football (m): Bravo - Celje, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Bravo - Celje, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (m): Bravo - Celje, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Bravo - Celje, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Slovenian moments, broadcasts Hungarian TV, Mon. / Slovenski utrinki, oddaja madžarske TV, pon.
programme.desc: In this show you can see a half -hour movie about four mills on the Slovenian and Hungarian side of the border, which are linked in a European project with an acronym from mill to mill. As part of the project, the powertrain of the Fila Mill in Gornji Senik in Porabje was renovated and the roof of Babic's mill in Veržej on the right bank of the Mura. At the Mali Šetor Mill in Šmartno na Pohorje or at Žaga in the Hungarian pre -alpine settlement Velem, they plan to host events. In our film you can get to know the past, present and future of these four mills, and you will also learn that the project partners are planning to establish a dispersed cross -border milling museum. / V tokratni oddaji si lahko ogledate polurni film o štirih mlinih na slovenski in madžarski strani meje, ki so povezani v evropskem projektu z akronimom Od mlina do mlina. V sklopu projekta se je prenovil pogonski sistem Filovega mlina na Gornjem Seniku v Porabju in zamenjala streha Babičevega mlina v Veržeju na desnem bregu Mure. Pri malem Šetorovem mlinu v Šmartnem na Pohorju oziroma pri žagi v madžarskem predalpskem naselju Velem pa nameravajo prirejati dogodke. V našem filmu lahko spoznate preteklost, sedanjost in prihodnost teh štirih mlinov, izvedeli pa boste tudi, da projektni partnerji načrtujejo vzpostavitev razpršenega čezmejnega mlinarskega muzeja.

These were the beginnings of artistic experimentation, which then became a recognizable voice of the Unikum Cultural Center. / Naš gost je glasbenik, komponist, kulturni delavec in eden od nekdanjih vodij Kulturnega centra univerze v Celovcu UNIKUM, ki bo prihodnje leto obeležil svoje štirideseto leto delovanja. Emil Krištof je častni prstan prejel za družbenokritične, interdisciplinarne umetnostne in kulturne projekte v alpsko-jadranskem prostoru. Dvojezičnost je za nas bila samoumevna, bila pa je tudi političen statement, poudarja. To so bili začetki umetniškega eksperimentiranja, ki so nato postali prepoznaven glas kulturnega centra UNIKUM.

programme.title: Hungry, barefoot and famous, documentary, Mon. / Lačni, bosi in slavni, dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Benjamin Kreže... Dokumentarni film skozi prikaz skoraj povsem pozabljenega fenomena mladinskega pevskega zbora, ki so ga v 30. letih prejšnjega stoletja poimenovali “Trboveljski slavček”, govori o tem, kako je v nemogočih razmerah in v od vseh pozab
programme.desc: The movie about the Trbovlje Slavček, as it was called in the early 30s, is the story of the Youth Choir, in which children from the poorest mining families sang, without any music education. Their leader August Shuligoj, by profession, who fled from Primorska, raised them to such a level that in 1936, at the first international music congress in Prague, from 600 then leading musicologists, they were chosen as the best choir in the world, even better than the famous Viennese boys. The songs they sang were so difficult that all these experts, before their performance, just shook their heads. Some songs were written atonal and even bononal, and according to musicologists, impossible for performing, but of course these simple children did not know it and were cheerfully sang. There is still no choir that can be done. They performed all over Europe in the most elite halls. They were followed by admirers, which was a unique phenomenon at the time. The Talk Slavček performed poems of renowned composers of the time, such as Emil Adamic, Slavko Osterc, Lucijan Marija Škerjanc, Marij Kogoj, Matija Bravničar, Matija Tomc Papandopulo and others. Some of them wrote songs specifically for this choir. However, the Trbovlje Slavček was not always rosy, since from the very beginning of the authorities they opposed the work of the choir, and made it difficult for him to work in various ways. They did not like that children who were supposed to grow into workers would engage in culture, and want such successes and approvals everywhere. It was the first direct radio transfer from Europe to America! The concert was estimated to be accompanied by over 6 million US listeners. Later, they were also invited to a three -month tour of America, but it never happened due to the coming war. / Film o Trboveljskem slavčku, kot so ga poimenovali na začetku 30. letih dvajsetegastoletja, pripoveduje zgodbo o mladinskem pevskem zboru, v katerem so prepevali otroci iz najrevnejših rudarskih družin, brez vsake glasbene izobrazbe. Njihov vodja Avgust Šuligoj, po poklicu učitelj, ki je prebegnil iz Primorske, jih je povzdignil na takšno raven, da so bili leta 1936 na prvem mednarodnem glasbenem kongresu v Pragi, od 600 takrat vodilnih muzikologov, izbrani kot najboljši pevski zbor na svetu, celo boljši od znamenitih Dunajskih dečkov. Skladbe, ki so jih prepevali so bile tako težke, da so vsi ti strokovnjaki, pred njihovim nastopom, le zmajevali z glavami. Nekatere skladbe so bile pisane atonalno in celo bitonalno in po mnenju muzikologov nemogoče za izvedbo, vendar pa ti preprosti otroci tega seveda niso vedeli in so jih veselo prepevali. Še danes ni zbora, ki bi bil to sposoben izvesti. Nastopali so po celi Evropi in to v najbolj elitnih dvoranah. Na turnejah so jim sledili občudovalci, kar je bil takrat edinstven fenomen.Trboveljski slavček je v letih 1930 do 1941 izvajal pesmi uglednih skladateljev tistega časa, kot so bili Emil Adamič, Slavko Osterc, Lucijan Marija Škerjanc, Marij Kogoj, Matija Bravničar, Danilo Švara, Matija Tomc, Ivan Matetić Ronjgov, Boris Papandopulo in drugi. Nekateri od njih so skladbe pisali posebej za ta zbor.Pot Trboveljskega slavčka pa ni bila vedno rožnata, saj so že od vsega začetka oblasti nasprotovale delovanju zbora, ter mu ves čas na razne načine oteževale delo. Ni jim bilo po godu, da bi se otroci, ki naj bi zrasli v delavce, ukvarjali s kulturo, ter želi povsod takšne uspehe in odobravanja.Zaradi svojih izjemnih uspehov so bili leta 1938 izbrani, da iz ljubljanskega studija, preko radijskih valov, izvedejo koncert za ameriški šolski radio. To je bil prvi neposredni radijski prenos iz Evrope v Ameriko! Koncert je po ocenah spremljalo preko 6 milijonov ameriških poslušalcev. Kasneje so bili tudi povabljeni na trimesečno turnejo po Ameriki, vendar se zaradi prihajajoče vojne to nikoli ni zgodilo.

programme.title: Osmi and, PON. / Osmi dan, pon.
programme.desc: We visited the 31. Sarajevo Film Festival, the largest event of its kind in Southeastern Europe. He was also marked by the participation of Slovenian creators this year, the feature film Fantasy Director Kukla was ranked in the competition program, and the world premiere was burning white on ninety Marko Naberšnik there. We checked the pulse of the city during the festival and talked to many festival guests. At the Festival of Poetry and Wine Festival, we met with honorable guests, a poet of Nicaragua Giocondo Belli and Macedonian poet Nikola Madzirov. Gioconda Belli is considered to be genuine -women's poetry, in its works we do not find classic feminist content, but is distinguished by its genuine political, social and cultural voice of the poet. The poetry of the Macedonian writer Nikola Madzirov is still heavily marked by a deep historical tradition, and the breakup of Yugoslavia at the age of 18 has greatly influenced his sense of identity. Intermedia artist Marko Peljhan, who develops Isolabs project within the ECOC, says that the Soča River offers us answers to questions in the context of aesthetics. As part of the project, it creates a digital twin of the Soča Valley in extremely high resolution. We visited him in Vipava, where he operates in one of the leading development projects there. Gorica was visited by renowned Swiss director Barbara Miller, who made the last interview with Dalai Lama. In the documentary film Wisdom of Happiness, the 90-year-old leader of Tibetan Buddhists and Nobel laureate for peace presents us with the key challenges of life in the 21th century. / Obiskali smo 31. Sarajevski filmski festival, največji tovrstni dogodek v jugovzhodni Evropi. Tudi letos ga je zaznamovala udeležba slovenskih ustvarjalcev, celovečerni film Fantasy režiserke Kukle se je uvrstil v tekmovalni program, svetovno premiero je tam doživel film Belo se pere na devetdeset Marka Naberšnika. Preverili smo utrip mesta med festivalom ter se pogovarjali s številnimi gosti festivala. Na festivalu Dnevi poezije in vina smo se srečali s častnima gostoma, pesnico iz Nikaragve Giocondo Belli in makedonskim pesnikom Nikolo Madžirovom. Gioconda Belli velja za pristni -ženski glas- poezije, v njenih delih namreč ne najdemo klasičnih feminističnih vsebin, temveč jo odlikuje pristen politični, socialni in kulturni glas pesnice. Poezija makedonskega književnika Nikole Madžirova pa je še vedno močno zaznamovana z globoko zgodovinsko tradicijo, razpad Jugoslavije pri njegovih 18 letih je namreč močno vplival na njegov občutek identitete. Intermedijski umetnik Marko Peljhan, ki v okviru EPK razvija projekt Isolabs, pravi, da nam reka Soča ponuja odgovore na vprašanja v kontekstu estetike. V okviru projekta ustvarja digitalni dvojček doline Soče v izredno visoki ločljivosti. Obiskali smo ga v Vipavi, kjer deluje v enem od tamkajšnjih vodilnih razvojnih projektov. Gorico pa je obiskala priznana švicarska režiserka Barbara Miller, ki je posnela verjetno zadnji intervju z dalajlamo. V dokumentarnem filmu Modrost sreče nam 90-letni vodja tibetanskih budistov in Nobelov nagrajenec za mir predstavi ključne izzive življenja v 21. stoletju.

programme.title: The sole: to learn Catalan and visit to Lleida / El llenguado: Aprendre català i visita a Lleida
programme.desc: Guillem Albà returns to class, sings in Chinese and castles, looking for the reasons why someone wants or does not want to learn Catalan. Why do adults learn Catalan, and how do they do it? Yolanda Sey will travel to Lleida, in search of the Catalan of the West. / Guillem Albà torna a classe, canta en xinès i fa castells, tot buscant els motius pels quals algú vol o no vol aprendre català. programme.title: Doc Martin / Doc Martin
programme.desc: It is the day of the wedding of Lal and Morwenna, and they are so complicated that the couple is ready to date the ceremony. But Joe, who is a godfather, helps them move forward and gain more and more prominence in the celebration. / És el dia del casament de lAl i la Morwenna, i sacumulen tantes complicacions que la parella està a punt dajornar la cerimònia. Però el Joe, que fa de padrí, els ajuda a tirar endavant i agafa cada vegada mes protagonisme en la celebracio.

programme.title: Doc Martin / Doc Martin
programme.desc: Martin has no longer served as a doctor and devotes time to fixing clocks and taking care of the scoundrel. Mrs. Tishell organizes a collection of signatures to get Dr. to return. / El Martin fa un any que ja no exerceix de metge i dedica el temps a arreglar rellotges i cuidar la canalla. programme.title: Downton Abbey / Downton Abbey
programme.desc: Robert takes out his competitive side; Violet's granddaughter arrives. / Robert saca su lado competitivo; llega la sobrina nieta de Violet.

programme.title: North Gran / Gran Nord
programme.desc: The Quico is not well and stays at home for Lanna and Dr. Rodes. Until Joan and Frederica, who are in France in a fairly unique funeral, call him to ask for help. In the meantime, the Mossos are preparing for the traditional football game against Gendarmerie. A meeting that no one wants to play and will start with another Dauxil call. / El Quico no es troba be i es queda a casa obligat per lAnna i la Doctora Rodes. Fins que el Joan i la Frederica, que son a França en un funeral força singular, el truquen per demanar-li ajuda. Mentrestant, els Mossos es preparen pel tradicional partit de futbol contra la Gendarmerie. Un encontre que ningú vol jugar i que començarà amb una altra trucada dauxili.

programme.title: White on white: reality / Blanc sobre blanc: Realitat
programme.desc: The Saproxima program in the open of two artists and investigates how they perceive beauty or how the materials they use. A mes, entra al taller de lartista i descobreix el seu espai de treball, autèntic indret de creacio.

programme.title: Murder in the north / Asesinato en el norte
programme.desc: The aunts of Finn Kieseawetter ask you to go home for a few days. programme.title: ECO Talk / ECO Talk
programme.sub-title: Eigenmietwert: Wie viel kostet uns die Abschaffung?
programme.desc: On September 28th, Switzerland coordinates a system change in residential property taxation. If the template is accepted, home owners' owners have to no longer tax their own rental value, but also cause fewer tax deductions. The opponents of the template warn of tax failures of up to two billion francs, for which the medium -sized companies in particular have to arise. The appraisers argue that the rental value is a “ghost tax” on a fictional income and therefore befitted. Is it now falling? Reto Lipp discusses in the “Eco Talk” with SP international Samira Marti and center-enthusiast Brigitte Haberli-Koller. / Am 28. September stimmt die Schweiz uber einen Systemwechsel bei der Wohneigentumsbesteuerung ab. Wird die Vorlage angenommen, mussen Hauseigentumerinnen und -eigentumer den Eigenmietwert kunftig nicht mehr versteuern, durfen aber auch weniger Steuerabzuge geltend machen. Die Gegner der Vorlage warnen vor Steuerausfallen von bis zu zwei Milliarden Franken, fur die vor allem der Mittelstand aufkommen musse. Die Befurworterinnen argumentieren, der Eigenmietwert sei eine «Geistersteuer» auf ein fiktives Einkommen und gehore deshalb abgeschafft.Wird die schon lange umkampfte Steuer nun fallen? Daruber diskutiert Reto Lipp im «Eco Talk» mit SP-Nationalratin Samira Marti und Mitte-Standeratin Brigitte Haberli-Koller.

programme.title: Children of the sun - our butterflies / Kinder der Sonne - Unsere Schmetterlinge
programme.desc: The career of the butterflies is fascinating and mysterious. The pupation of the inconspicuous caterpillars and the slip of the fragile homes flash the imagination. The delicate insects do very respectable performance: non-stop flight over the Alps or the sea. They are also defensive against their natural enemies: they threaten them with huge eyes on the airs or defend themselves with a poison cocktail. However, the butterflies are powerless against the disappearance of their natural habitat. / Der Werdegang der Schmetterlinge ist faszinierend und geheimnisvoll. Die Verpuppung der unscheinbaren Raupen und das Schlupfen der fragilen Schonheiten beflugeln die Fantasie. Die zartgliedrigen Insekten vollbringen durchaus respektable Leistungen: Nonstop-Fluge uber die Alpen oder das Meer. Auch gegen ihre naturlichen Feinde sind sie durchaus wehrhaft: Sie drohen ihnen mit riesigen Augen auf den Flugeln oder verteidigen sich mit einem Giftcocktail. Gegen das Verschwinden ihres naturlichen Lebensraums sind die Schmetterlinge allerdings machtlos.

programme.title: Police officer Wackerli in danger / Polizist Wackerli in Gefahr
programme.desc: Cantonal policeman Gottfried Wackerli has been causing calm and order in the tranquil village of Oeppenau for many years. He knows the worries and grade of his coburger, has the heart in the right place and knows exactly whether he can get an eye or has to take a hard time. His 60th birthday is in front of the tur, but the anticipation is limited. At home he stands on war foot with son Ruedi (Rene Scheibli), while his wife Hedwig is still in his hair with the daughter -in -law Annelies. But Wackerli is also under pressure: An expensive drilling machine was stolen from an expensive drill, and Huft belts and cake letters disappear on the ongoing volume of community prasident Gasser. Wackerli goes to work and even forgets his birthday. No wonder, because for some time now the Hubsche Saler Susy Duggeli has been making it beautiful. She is friends with Alois “Hugu” bird, who together with his cousin Feusi, dubious. Wackerli suspects the two of having stolen the drill. And then a murder happens in Oeppenau, and this bose does - unexpectedly - bring the Wackerli family together again. «Policeist Wackerli was in danger», in 1967, i.e. a whole year after the legendary Wackerli film by Kurt Fruh. This time the Swiss actor Sigfrit Steiner, who died in 1988. Steiner also wrote the script together with the main actor and Wackerli inventor Schaggi Streuli. Juliana Vonderlinn gave her feature film debut here. In the long list of performers you will find Margrit Rainer, Paul Buhlmann, Elisabeth Schnell, Rainer Litten and in one of his early film roles Jorg Schneider.Zum Film itself was as well as read in the cinema program book as well as aptly: «Although a policeman is in the center, it is not a crime film, despite a lot of humor, not a comedy film and despite the small flirts. It is a Swiss film, factual and without exaggeration. We Swiss are in a reputation to complete and isolate ourselves. Nevertheless, we like to take a look at the neighbor. It is good to know that he too has his small and big worries and that he will be able to finish in his own way. » / Kantonspolizist Gottfried Wackerli sorgt im beschaulichen Dorf Oeppenau seit vielen Jahren fur Ruhe und Ordnung. Er kennt die Sorgen und Note seiner Mitburger, hat das Herz auf dem rechten Fleck und weiss jeweils genau, ob er ein Auge zudrucken kann oder hart durchgreifen muss.Sein 60. Geburtstag steht vor der Tur, doch die Vorfreude halt sich in Grenzen. Zu Hause steht er auf Kriegsfuss mit Sohn Ruedi (Rene Scheibli), wahrend sich seine Frau Hedwig standig mit der Schwiegertochter Annelies in den Haaren liegt. Aber auch beruflich ist Wackerli unter Druck: Einem Garagisten wurde eine teure Bohrmaschine gestohlen, und im Kaufhaus von Gemeindeprasident Gasser verschwinden am laufenden Band Huftgurtel und Kuchenschurzen.Wackerli geht an die Arbeit und vergisst daruber sogar fast seinen Geburtstag. Kein Wunder, denn seit einiger Zeit macht ihm die hubsche Verkauferin Susy Duggeli schone Augen. Sie ist mit Alois «Hugu»-Vogeli befreundet, der gemeinsam mit seinem Cousin Feusi dubiose Geschafte tatigt.Zurzeit erwarten die beiden, ein Grundstuck ihrer gerade verstorbenen Tante zu erben, und hoffen, daraus kraftig Kapital zu schlagen. Wackerli verdachtigt die beiden, die Bohrmaschine entwendet zu haben. Und dann geschieht ein Mord in Oeppenau, und diese bose Tat bringt - ganz unerwartet - die Familie Wackerli wieder zusammen.«Polizist Wackerli in Gefahr» entstand 1967, also ganze zwolf Jahre nach dem legendaren Wackerli-Film von Kurt Fruh. Regie fuhrte diesmal der 1988 verstorbene Schweizer Schauspieler Sigfrit Steiner. Steiner schrieb zusammen mit Hauptdarsteller und Wackerli-Erfinder Schaggi Streuli auch das Drehbuch. Juliana Vonderlinn gab hier ihr Spielfilmdebut. In der langen Darstellerliste findet man Margrit Rainer, Paul Buhlmann, Elisabeth Schnell, Rainer Litten sowie in einer seiner fruhen Filmrollen Jorg Schneider.Zum Film selbst war damals im Kinoprogrammheft ebenso nuchtern wie treffend zu lesen: «Obwohl ein Polizist im Mittelpunkt steht, ist es kein Kriminalfilm, trotz viel Humor kein Lustspielfilm und trotz den kleinen Flirts kein Liebesfilm. Es ist ein Schweizerfilm, sachlich und ohne Übertreibungen. Wir Schweizer stehen im Ruf, uns abzuschliessen und zu isolieren. Trotzdem schauen wir ganz gern einmal dem Nachbarn in die Stube. Es ist gut zu wissen, dass auch er seine kleinen und grossen Sorgen hat und auf seine Weise damit fertig wird.»

programme.title: Katie Fforde: Pretty best friends / Katie Fforde: Ziemlich beste Freundinnen
programme.desc: The single hotel owner Paula Atkinson (Henriette Richter-Rohl) and her impulsive girlfriend Emily van Garden have known each other since the high school. They have always been able to rely on each other - even now. Because just a few days before her wedding, Emily caught her fiance Frank with another in bed. It is clear that in this love crisis she can pay for her friend's support and pulls into Paulas's “Seaside Hotel”, but Paula also goes through a rambling time: After a bad diagnosis when visiting a doctor, she realizes that in an emergency nobody will be there for her nine -year -old daughter Lucy. So Paula and Emily decide to marry spontaneously. But not all people in their environment react positively to this project. In particular, Frank cannot accept that Emily does not want to give him a second chance. Emily's parents Linda and Douglas, on the other hand, keep themselves incredibly tolerant. But if they are actually as liberal as they think? When the wedding jerks closer, Emily has to admit that their feelings for Frank Langst are not cowed up. But she gave Paula a promise that she absolutely wants to stick to. The two say yes. But after the wedding, Paula Emily reveals a secret that finally ensures base chaos. / Die alleinerziehende Hotelbesitzerin Paula Atkinson (Henriette Richter-Rohl) und ihre impulsive Freundin Emily van Garden kennen sich seit der Highschool. Schon immer konnten sie sich aufeinander verlassen - so auch jetzt. Denn nur wenige Tage vor ihrer Hochzeit erwischt Emily ihren Verlobten Frank mit einer anderen im Bett. Klar ist, dass sie in dieser Liebeskrise auf die Unterstutzung ihrer Freundin zahlen kann und in Paulas «Seaside Hotel» zieht.Doch auch Paula macht eine aufwuhlende Zeit durch: Nach einer schlimmen Diagnose bei einem Arztbesuch wird ihr klar, dass im Notfall niemand fur ihre neunjahrige Tochter Lucy da sein wird. Also beschliessen Paula und Emily spontan zu heiraten. Doch nicht alle Menschen in ihrem Umfeld reagieren positiv auf dieses Vorhaben. Vor allem Frank kann sich nicht damit abfinden, dass Emily ihm keine zweite Chance geben will. Emilys Eltern Linda und Douglas hingegen halten sich selbst fur unglaublich tolerant. Aber sind sie tatsachlich so liberal, wie sie denken?Als die Hochzeit naher ruckt, muss sich Emily eingestehen, dass ihre Gefuhle fur Frank langst nicht abgekuhlt sind. Doch sie hat Paula ein Versprechen gegeben, an das sie sich unbedingt halten will. Die beiden geben sich das Ja-Wort. Doch nach der Hochzeit offenbart Paula Emily ein Geheimnis, das endgultig fur Gefuhlschaos sorgt.

programme.title: ECO Talk / ECO Talk
programme.sub-title: Eigenmietwert: Wie viel kostet uns die Abschaffung?
programme.desc: On September 28th, Switzerland coordinates a system change in residential property taxation. If the template is accepted, home owners' owners have to no longer tax their own rental value, but also cause fewer tax deductions. The opponents of the template warn of tax failures of up to two billion francs, for which the medium -sized companies in particular have to arise. The appraisers argue that the rental value is a “ghost tax” on a fictional income and therefore befitted. Is it now falling? Reto Lipp discusses in the “Eco Talk” with SP international Samira Marti and center-enthusiast Brigitte Haberli-Koller. / Am 28. September stimmt die Schweiz uber einen Systemwechsel bei der Wohneigentumsbesteuerung ab. Wird die Vorlage angenommen, mussen Hauseigentumerinnen und -eigentumer den Eigenmietwert kunftig nicht mehr versteuern, durfen aber auch weniger Steuerabzuge geltend machen. Die Gegner der Vorlage warnen vor Steuerausfallen von bis zu zwei Milliarden Franken, fur die vor allem der Mittelstand aufkommen musse. Die Befurworterinnen argumentieren, der Eigenmietwert sei eine «Geistersteuer» auf ein fiktives Einkommen und gehore deshalb abgeschafft.Wird die schon lange umkampfte Steuer nun fallen? Daruber diskutiert Reto Lipp im «Eco Talk» mit SP-Nationalratin Samira Marti und Mitte-Standeratin Brigitte Haberli-Koller.

programme.title: SRF bi de Lut / SRF bi de Lut
programme.desc: At the end of the season, the country women travel to Romandia - more precisely to Nyon. Barbara Bernegger lives there with her family on the accompanying Gut Domaine Bois-Bougy, not far from the picturesque town. They grow up bilingual, as has been the case on the Domaine Bois-Bougy for four generations. The family manages around 70 hectares of land. Sugar tubes, wheat, barley, corn, rapeseed and grapes thrive around the courtyard. Other important businesses are the dairy cow husbandry and its own bed and breakfast that Barbara has set up in the western part of the property. Haring Barbara's man Samuel above all about the animals and field work, she is conditional for everything around the house. Cooking takes up a large part of your work. Because not only the six -headed family is sitting at the lunch table, but also three employees and two apprentices take a seat. And Barbara makes sure that there is not only pasta on the table. Instead, she also cooks with regional products at noon and almost exclusively. She describes her kuche herself as traditionally with various influences from German and western Switzerland. The crux: Your three swing has to prepare it à la minute. This is not an easy undertaking if the nerves flutter. / Zum Schluss der Staffel reisen die Landfrauen in die Romandie - genauer nach Nyon. Barbara Bernegger lebt dort mit ihrer Familie auf dem altehrwurdigen Gut Domaine Bois-Bougy, unweit des malerischen Stadtchens.Zusammen mit ihrem Mann Samuel hat Barbara vier Kinder im Schulalter. Sie wachsen zweisprachig auf, so wie es auf der Domaine Bois-Bougy bereits seit vier Generationen der Fall ist. Die Familie bewirtschaftet rund 70 Hektaren Land. Zuckerruben, Weizen, Gersten, Mais, Raps und Trauben gedeihen rund um den Hof. Weitere wichtige Erwerbszweige sind die Milchkuhhaltung und das eigene Bed and Breakfast, das Barbara im Westteil des Anwesens eingerichtet hat.Wahrend Barbaras Mann Samuel sich vor allem um die Tiere und die Feldarbeit kummert, ist sie fur alles rund ums Haus zustandig. Das Kochen nimmt dabei einen grossen Teil ihrer Arbeit ein. Denn am Mittagstisch sitzt nicht nur die sechskopfige Familie, sondern da nehmen auch drei Angestellte und zwei Lehrlinge Platz. Und Barbara achtet darauf, dass nicht nur Teigwaren auf den Tisch kommen. Stattdessen kocht sie auch am Mittag aufwandig und fast ausschliesslich mit regionalen Produkten. Ihre Kuche bezeichnet sie selbst als traditionell mit verschiedenen Einflussen aus der Deutsch- und Westschweiz.Auch den Landfrauen serviert Barbara fast ausschliesslich Produkte vom eigenen Hof. Die Crux: Ihre drei Gange muss sie à la minute zubereiten. Das ist kein leichtes Unterfangen, wenn zusatzlich noch die Nerven flattern.

programme.title: healthy / gesundheitheute
programme.desc: The arms and legs are paralyzed by tetra leagers, for example as a result of an accident. You have to spend your life in a wheelchair - and nothing is as before. In order to enable those affected to make great self -accuracy, research is intensively researched. “Health hay” shows the history of a cross -sectional man who could benefit from a new drug. Ruckenmark injuries after a cross -sectional expression can lead to problems of the bladder function, which can consider the quality of life of the affected person considerably and even become life -threatening. So far there has been no therapy that could stop the continuous breakdown of the bladder function. Researchers are currently testing a new therapy approach in which electricity is used. This method is referred to as neuromodulation. / Bei Tetraplegikerinnen und Tetraplegikern sind Arme und Beine gelahmt, zum Beispiel als Folge eines Unfalls. Sie mussen ihr Leben im Rollstuhl verbringen - und nichts ist mehr wie zuvor. Um Betroffenen die grosstmogliche Selbststandigkeit zu ermoglichen, wird intensiv geforscht. «GESUNDHEITHEUTE» zeigt die Geschichte eines querschnittgelahmten Mannes, der von einem neuartigen Medikament profitieren konnte.Ruckenmarksverletzungen nach einer Querschnittlahmung konnen zu Problemen der Blasenfunktion fuhren, was die Lebensqualitat der Betroffenen erheblich einschranken und sogar lebensbedrohlich werden kann. Bislang gab es keine Therapie, die den kontinuierlichen Abbau der Blasenfunktion aufhalten konnte. Aktuell testen Forschende einen neuen Therapieansatz, bei dem Strom zum Einsatz kommt. Diese Methode wird als Neuromodulation bezeichnet.

programme.desc: Marco Ritter is killed at a viewpoint above Wiesbaden. Chief Prosecutor Reuther heads the investigation into the murder of the young personal trainer. programme.title: Bird in the Peninsula / Bird in the Peninsula
programme.desc: The idea for “Bird in the Peninsula” came Wada ten years ago when he saw a documentary about a Japanese ritual with children in a village. When he noticed that the children seemed to be practicing the ritual, he started thinking about his meaning and drew a storyboard. After a long break, he took up the idea in 2019. The short film explores the questions: What is a ritual? What does it mean to grow up? Attsushi Wada (*1980) studied at the Osaka Kyoiku Universitat, at the Image Forum Institute of the Moving Image and at the art college in Tokyo. In 2002 he started with animation in self -study. Films: «My Exercise» (2020), «The Great Rabbit» (2012), «In a Pigs Eye» (2010), «The Mechanism of Spring» (2010). / Die Idee zu «Bird in the Peninsula» kam Wada vor zehn Jahren, als er einen Dokumentarfilm uber ein japanisches Ritual mit Kindern in einem Dorf sah. Als ihm auffiel, dass den Kindern das Üben des Rituals anscheinend nicht gefiel, fing er an, uber dessen Sinn nachzudenken und zeichnete ein Storyboard.Nach einer langeren Pause nahm er 2019 die Idee wieder auf. Der Kurzfilm geht den Fragen nach: Was ist ein Ritual? Was bedeutet es, erwachsen zu werden?Atsushi Wada (*1980) studierte an der Osaka Kyoiku Universitat, am Image Forum Institute of the Moving Image und an der Kunsthochschule in Tokyo. 2002 startete er mit Animieren im Selbststudium.Filme : «My Exercise» (2020), «The Great Rabbit» (2012), «In a Pigs Eye» (2010), «The Mechanism of Spring» (2010).

programme.title: Global disorder - endless crises / Globale Unordnung - Krisen ohne Ende
programme.desc: A war has been raging in Eastern Europe for three and a half years. Or since 2014. Or not at all, because Russia is known to speak of a “special surgery”. Selbst die Schweiz, die sich einst erfolgreich aus allem raushielt, ist nun von Donald Trumps wankelmutiger Zollpolitik betroffen. Wo man auch hinschaut: Nationalismus, Populismus und Autoritarismus sind auf dem Vormarsch.Was geschieht hier eigentlich gerade? Und wie kam es zu dieser umgreifenden Destabilisierung? Bringen mehr Waffen weniger Krieg? Oder mehr? Und was, wenn Russland gewinnt?Auf der Suche nach Antworten auf all diese komplexen Fragen spricht Olivia Rollin mit dem deutschen Politikwissenschaftler und Experten fur internationale Politik Carlo Masala und der Schweizer UN-Botschafterin in New York Pascale Baeriswyl.

programme.desc: Iveth wears orange rubber gloves, sweat runs over your forehead. She cleans the Rising Phoenix Beach in Accra, the capital of Ghana, the beach of second -hand clothes. «Africa is a continent, not a mulle. That has to stop! », She says. He imports new goods from China. The 24-year textile designer Khalifina earns a living with the second hand dresses. She chooses the best stucco on the market, upcycles it and sells it online: "Giving clothes back to life is important to me." But the trade with the old dresses has dark sides. Around 40 percent of all clothing of the Cantamanto market end up on illegal mullhalden. The huge mountains of waste commit the picture in Old Fadama, Accra's greatest slum. "The global north has to fry her textile production in order to stop this environmental disaster," demands David, who works for an NGO that deals with the old clothing topic. He also wishes that the government in Accra finds a sustainable solution for the textile drop. To date, there is no infrastructure in Ghana for waste recycling. / Iveth tragt orange Gummihandschuhe, Schweiss lauft ihr uber die Stirn. Gereizt saubert sie am Rising Phoenix Beach in Accra, der Hauptstadt von Ghana, den Strand von Secondhandkleidern. «Afrika ist ein Kontinent, keine Mullhalde. Das muss aufhoren!», sagt sie.Die Altkleider aus dem globalen Norden werden von ghanaischen Alterkleiderhandlern importiert. Bernard Owona ist seit zehn Jahren Handler auf einem der grossten Kleidermarkte der Welt, dem Kantamanto-Markt. Fur ihn ist der Import von ganzen Kleidercontainern ein lukratives Geschaft. Er importiert neue Ware aus China.Die 24-jahrige Textildesignerin Khalifina verdient ihren Lebensunterhalt mit den Secondhandkleidern. Sie sucht auf dem Markt die besten Stucke aus, upcycelt sie und verkauft sie online: «Kleidung wieder zum Leben zu erwecken, liegt mir am Herzen.»Doch der Handel mit den Altkleidern hat Schattenseiten. Rund 40 Prozent aller Kleidungsstucke des Kantamanto-Marktes landen auf illegalen Mullhalden. Wie besessen will sie jedes Detail kennen und begreifen, was Nina zum Suizid verleitete. Sie freundet sich mit Ninas Mann Roy und ihrem Sohn Casey an. Dabei kommen nach und nach nicht nur die Geheimnisse der Verstorbenen an die Oberflache, sondern Claire muss sich auch ihrer eigenen tragischen Vergangenheit stellen.Hollywoodstar Jennifer Aniston verwandelte sich fur «Cake» in eine verbitterte Frau, sodass man sie beinahe nicht wiedererkennt. Sie schreckte nicht davor zuruck, die leidgeprufte Claire in aller Konsequenz darzustellen und dafur ihr stets perfektes Image als einer der beliebtesten Stars von romantischen Komodien abzulegen. Mit einem Oscar wurde sie dafur nicht belohnt - wie etwa Charlize Theron nach ahnlicher Verwandlung in «Monster» - doch liefert sie trotzdem eine beeindruckende Leistung ab und tragt das taffe Drama mit vollem Einsatz.

Im Laufe der Jahre wurde die Sendung immer wieder angepasst - an die technologischen Entwicklungen, vor allem aber an die Bedurfnisse des Publikums. Gleich geblieben ist der Anspruch, jeden Abend die wichtigsten Themen im In- und Ausland kurz und verstandlich aufzubereiten.Die «Tagesschau vor 20 Jahren» bietet einen Nachrichtenruckblick in die jungere Geschichte: Welche Themen bewegten heute vor exakt 20 Jahren? programme.desc: At the end of the season, the country women travel to Romandia - more precisely to Nyon. Barbara Bernegger lives there with her family on the accompanying Gut Domaine Bois-Bougy, not far from the picturesque town. They grow up bilingual, as has been the case on the Domaine Bois-Bougy for four generations. The family manages around 70 hectares of land. Sugar tubes, wheat, barley, corn, rapeseed and grapes thrive around the courtyard. Other important businesses are the dairy cow husbandry and its own bed and breakfast that Barbara has set up in the western part of the property. Barbara Bernegger lebt dort mit ihrer Familie auf dem altehrwurdigen Gut Domaine Bois-Bougy, unweit des malerischen Stadtchens.Zusammen mit ihrem Mann Samuel hat Barbara vier Kinder im Schulalter. Sie wachsen zweisprachig auf, so wie es auf der Domaine Bois-Bougy bereits seit vier Generationen der Fall ist. Die Familie bewirtschaftet rund 70 Hektaren Land. Zuckerruben, Weizen, Gersten, Mais, Raps und Trauben gedeihen rund um den Hof. Weitere wichtige Erwerbszweige sind die Milchkuhhaltung und das eigene Bed and Breakfast, das Barbara im Westteil des Anwesens eingerichtet hat.Wahrend Barbaras Mann Samuel sich vor allem um die Tiere und die Feldarbeit kummert, ist sie fur alles rund ums Haus zustandig.
